a: O giyyoret – zacha!
Amar rabba: bigrusha. vechen amar rav nachman: bigrusha.
Amri: gerusha name tiflog bidme veladot!
Amar rav pappa: hattora zikketa deme veladot labbaal, afillu ba aleha biznut. may tama? amar kera "kaasher yashit alav baal haishsha".
Venokma lerabba kegon sheggavu maot, ulerav nachman kegon sheggavu karka!
Deamar rabba: gavu karka – yesh lo, gavu maot – en lo. verav nachman amar: gavu maot – yesh lo, gavu karka – en lo.
Hane mille livne mareva – allibba derabbanan;
Ki kaamri hacha – kerabbi.

Amar rabbi shimon ben lakish: shor shehemit et haeved shello bechavvavna – patur mishsheloshim shekalim, shenneemar: "kesef sheloshim shekalim yitten ladonav, vehashshor yissakel" – kol zeman shehashshor biskila, habbealim meshallemin sheloshim shekalim; en hashshor biskila, en habbealim meshallemin sheloshim shekalim.

Amar rabba: shor shehemit ben chorin shello bechavvavna – patur mikkofer, shenneemar: "hashshor yissakel, vegam bealav yumat. im kofer yushat alav" – kol zeman shehashshor biskila – bealim meshallemin kofer, en hashshor biskila – en bealim meshallemin kofer.
Etiveh abbaye: "hemit shori et peloni", o "shoro shel peloni" – hare ze meshallem al pi atzmo. may, lav kofer?
La, damim.
I damim, ema sefa: "hemit shori et avdo shel peloni" – eno meshallem al pi atzmo. vei damim, ammay la?
Amar leh, yachelna leshannoye lach: resha damim, vesefa kenas; mihu shinnuyay dechika la meshannena lach. idde veidde damim.
b: Mihu, ben chorin dimshallem kofer al pi atzmo – vehechi dame? dei ato sahade veashidu beh diktal, vela yadi i tam hava i muad hava, vaamar mareh demuad hu, dimshallem kofer al pi atzmo – hecha delekka edim, meshallem damim;

Gabbe eved, sheeno meshallem kenas al pi atzmo – vehechi dame? dei ato edim veashidu beh diktal, vela yadi i tam hava i muad hava, vaamar mareh muad hu – la mishtallam kenas al pi atzmo. hecha delekka edim – la meshallem damim.
Metiv rav shemuel bar rav yitzchak: kol shechayyayv beven chorin – chayyayv beeved, ben bechofer ben bemita.
Kofer beeved mi ikka?! ella lav damim?

Ikka deamri: hu motev la vehu mefarek la, ikka deamri: amar leh rabba – hachi katane: kol shechayyayv beven chorin bechavvavna al pi edim, kofer – chayyayv beeved kenas. vechol shechayyayv beven chorin shello bechavvavna al pi edim, damim – chayyayv beeved shello bechavvavna al pi edim, damim.
Amar leh rava: i hachi, ishsho shello bechavvavna al pi edim – neshallem damim!
Umena leh lerava dela meshallem?
Illema midditnan: haya gedi kafut lo, veeved samuch lo venisraf immo – chayyayv. eved kafut lo, ugedi samuch lo venisraf immo – patur.
Haamar resh lakish: kegon shehitztzit begufo shel eved, dekam leh bidrabba minneh!

Veella meha detanya: chomer beesh mibbevor – shehaesh muedet leechol ben davar harauy lah ben davar sheen rauy lah, ma sheen ken bevor. veillu shehaesh meshallemet shello bechavvavna damim – ma sheen ken bevor, la katane!
Dilma tena veshayyayr?
Ella rava gufeh ibbeoye mibbaya leh: ishsho shello bechavvavna – mi meshallem damim, o la?

Mi amrinan: gabbe shor hu divchavvavna meshallem kofer – shello bechavvavna meshallem damim; aval ishsho, divchavvavna la meshallem kofer – shello bechavvavna name la meshallem damim; o dilma, kevan degabbe shoro shello bechavvavna – af al gav delekka kofer, meshallem damim; gabbe ishsho name, af al gav divchavvavna la meshallem kofer, shello bechavvavna mihat meshallem damim?
Vela yadinan, teku.
Ki ata rav dimi, amar rabbi yochanan: "kofer"; ma talmud lomar "im kofer"? lerabbot kofer shello bechavvavna – kechofer bechavvavna.

Amar leh abbaye: ella meatta, eved name – ma talmud lomar "im eved"? lerabbot eved shello bechavvavna – keeved bechavvavna! vechi tema hachi name, vehaamar resh lakish: shor shehemit et haeved shello bechavvavna – patur mishsheloshim shekalim!
Amar leh: gavra aggavra ka ramet?!
Ki ata ravin, amar rabbi yochanan: "eved"; ma talmud lomar "im eved"? lerabbot eved shello bechavvavna – keeved bechavvavna.
Uleresh lakish name, nema: middeeved" – "im eved" la daresh, "kofer" – "im kofer" name la daresh!
Amri: la; "eved" – "im eved" la daresh, "kofer" – "im kofer" daresh.
Umay shena? "eved" – "im eved" la ketiv bimkom tashlumin, "kofer" – "im kofer" ketiv bimkom tashlumin.
Vechen beven o bevat. tanu rabbanan: "o ven yiggach o vat yiggach" – lechayyev al hakketannim kaggedolim.
Vahalo din hu – hoil vechiyyev adam beadam, vechiyyev shor beadam; ma keshechiyyev adam beadam – la shena ben ketannim ligdolim, af keshechiyyev shor beadam – lo tachlok bo ben ketannim ligdolim!
Veod, kal vachomer hu: uma adam beadam – shello asa bo ketannim kigdolim, chiyyev bo al hakketannim kigdolim;

a: Shor beadam – sheasa bo ketannim kigdolim, eno din shechayyayv al hakketannim kigdolim?
Lo, im amarta adam beadam – shekken chayyayv bearbaa devarim, tomar beshor – sheeno chayyayv bearbaa devarim? talmud lomar: "o ven yiggach o vat yiggach" – lechayyev al hakketannim kigdolim.
Veen li ella bemuadin, betam minnayin?
Din hu – hoil vechiyyev beish veishsha, vechiyyev beven uvat; ma keshechiyyev beish veishsha – lo chillakta bo ben tam lemuad; af keshechiyyev beven uvat – lo tachlok bo ben tam lemuad.
Veod, kal vachomer – ma ish veishsha, shekken hora kocham binzakin – lo chillakta bo ben tam lemuad; ben uvat, sheyyippa kocham binzakin – eno din shello tachlok bahen ben tam lemuad?
Amarta: vechi danin kal mechamur lehachemir alav? im hechmir bemuad hechamur, tachmir betam hakkal?
Veod: im amarta beish veishsha – shekken chayyayvin bemitzvot, tomar beven uvat – sheppeturin min hammitzvot?
Talmud lomar: "o ven yiggach o vat yiggach" – negicha betam negicha bemuad, negicha lemita negicha linzakin.
Mishna shor shehaya mitchakkech bakkotel – venafal al haadam; nitkavven laharog et habbehema – veharag et haadam; legoy – veharag ben yisrael; linfalim – veharag ben kayyayma; patur.
Gemara amar shemuel: patur mimmita, vechayyayv bechofer. verav amar: patur mizze umizze.
Veammay? ha tam hu! kidamar rav: bemuad lippol al bene adam bevorot, hacha name – bemuad lehitchakkech al bene adam bichtalim.
I hachi, bar ketala hu! bishlama hatam – dachaza yeroka unefal, ella hacha – may ikka lememar?
Hacha name – bemitchakkech bakkotel lahanaato. umena yadinan? devatar dinfal ka mitchakkach beh.
b: Veakkatti tzerorot ninhu! amar rav mari bereh derav kahana: dekaazel minneh minneh.
Tanya kevoteh dishmuel – uteyuveta derav: yesh chayyayv bemita uvechofer, veyesh chayyayv bechofer ufatur mimmita, veyesh chayyayv bemita ufatur min hakkofer, veyesh patur mizze umizze.

Ha ketzad? muad bechavvavna – chayyayv bemita uvechofer. muad shello bechavvavna – chayyayv bechofer ufatur mimmita. tam bechavvavna – chayyayv bemita ufatur mikkofer. tam shello bechavvavna – patur mizze umizze.
Vehannezakin shello bechavvavna – rabbi yehuda mechayyev, verabbi shimon poter.
May tama derabbi yehuda? yalef mikkofro; ma kofro – shello bechavvavna chayyayv, af hannezakin name – shello bechavvavna chayyayv.
Verabbi shimon yalef mikketaleh deshor, ma ketaleh – shello bechavvavna patur, af nezakin – shello bechavvavna patur.
Verabbi yehuda name, nelaf mikketaleh! danin tashlumin mittashlumin, veen danin tashlumin mimmita.
Verabbi shimon name, nelaf mikkofro! danin chiyyuveh deshor mechiyyuveh deshor, leappoke kofer dechiyyuveh divalim hu.

Nitkavven laharog et habbehema veharag et haadam [vechulei] – patur. ha nitkavven laharog et ze, veharag et ze – chayyayv, matnitin dela kerabbi shimon. detanya, rabbi shimon omer: afillu nitkavven laharog et ze, veharag et ze – patur.
May tama derabbi shimon? deamar kera: "hashshor yissakel vegam bealav yumat" – kemitat bealim, kach mitat hashshor; ma bealim – ad demikkavven leh, af shor name – ad demikkavven leh.
Uvealim gufayyhu menalan? deamar kera: "vearav lo vekam alav" – ad sheyyitkavven lo.
Verabbanan, hay "vearav lo" may avdi leh? amri deve rabbi yannay: perat lazzorek even lego.
Hechi dame? illema deikka tisha goyim veechad yisrael benehem – tippok leh derubba goyim ninhu; i name palga ufalga – sefek nefashot lehakel!

La tzericha, deikka tisha yisreelim veechad goy. deaf al gav derubba yisreelim ninhu; kevan deikka chado goy benayyhu – have leh kavua, vechol kavua kemechetza al mechetza dame, vesafek nefashot lehakel.

Mishna shor haishsha, veshor hayyetomim, shor haappotroppos, shor hammidbar, shor hahekdesh, shor hagger shemmet veen lo yorshin – hare ellu chayyayvin mita. rabbi yehuda omer: shor hammidbar, shor hahekdesh, shor hagger shemmet – peturin min hammita, lefi sheen lahem bealim.

Gemara tanu rabbanan: "shor" "shor" shiva – lehavi shor haishsha, shor hayyetomim, shor haappotroppos, shor hammidbar, shor hahekdesh, shor hagger shemmet veen lo yorshin. rabbi yehuda omer: shor hammidbar, shor hahekdesh, shor hagger shemmet veen lo yorshin – peturin min hammita, lefi sheen lahem bealim.
Amar rav huna: poter haya rabbi yehuda afillu nagach ulevassof hikdish, nagach ulevassof hifkir.

Mimmay? middekatane tarte – shor hammidbar, veshor hagger shemmet veen lo yorshin. shor hagger shemmet may nihu? dechevan deen lo yorshin – hava leh shor hefker; hayeynu shor hammidbar, hayeynu shor hagger shemmet veen lo yorshin! ella lav ha kamashma lan – daafillu nagach ulevassof hikdish, nagach ulevassof hifkir? shema minna.

Tanya name hachi, yater al ken amar rabbi yehuda: afillu nagach ulevassof hikdish, nagach ulevassof hifkir – patur, shenneemar: "vehuad bivalav" – "vehemit vegomer", ad shettehe mita vehaamada baddin shavin keechad.
Ugemar din la baenan? veha "hashshor yissakel" gemar din hu! ella ema: ad shettehe mita, vehaamada baddin, ugemar din shavin keechad.
Mishna shor shehu yotze lissakel, vehikdisho bealav – eno mukedash. shechato – besaro asur. veim ad shello nigmar dino hikdisho bealav – mukedash. veim shechato – besaro muttar.
Mesaro leshomer chinnam uleshoel lenose sachar ulesocher – nichnesu tachat habbealim; muad – meshallem nezek shalem, vetam – meshallem chatzi nezek.
Gemara tanu rabbanan: shor shehemit; ad shello nigmar dino – mecharo

a: Machur, hikdisho mukedash, shechato – besaro muttar, hechziro shomer levet bealav – muchezar.

Mishshennigmar dino – mecharo eno machur, hikdisho eno mukedash, shechato – besaro asur, hechziro shomer levet bealav – eno muchezar. rabbi yaakov omer: af mishshennigmar dino – hechziro shomer livalav, muchezar.
Lema beha kamippalgi – derabbanan savri: en omrin beissure hanaa "hare shellecha lefanecha", verabbi yaakov savar: omrin beissure hanaa "hare shellecha lefanecha"?
Amar rabba: dechulle alma omrin beissure hanaa "hare shellecha lefanecha", deim ken – niflog leinyan chametz bappesach.

Ella hacha, begomrin dino shel shor shello befanav kamippalgi – derabbanan savri: en gomrin dino shel shor ella befanav; deamar leh: i ahdarteh nihali – hava marekna leh leagma, hasheta – atpasteh letoray bida dela yachelna leishtaoye dina bahadeh.
Verabbi yaakov savar: gomrin dino shel shor shello befanav – deamar leh: sof sof migmar havo gamri leh ledina.
May tama derabbanan? "hashshor yissakel vegam bealav yumat" – kemitat habbealim kach mitat hashshor; ma bealim bifnehem, af shor befanav.
Verabbi yaakov – bishlama bealim, bene taana ninhu; ella shor, bar taanta hu?

Mesaro leshomer chinnam uleshoel kulei. tanu rabbanan: arbaa nichnesu tachat habbealim, veellu hen: shomer chinnam vehashshoel nose sachar vehassocher. hargu tammin – neheragin, ufeturin min hakkofer. muadin – neheragin, umeshallemin et hakkofer. vechayyayvin lehachazir deme shor livalav, chutz mishshomer chinnam.
Amri: hechi dame? i denatreh – afillu kullehu name lippatru! vei dela natreh – afillu shomer chinnam nichayyayv!
Amri: hacha bemay askinan – denatreh shemira pechuta, vela natreh shemira meulla. shomer chinnam – kalta lo shemirato, hanach – la kalta shemiratan.
Amri: keman? i kerabbi meir,
b: Deamar: socher keshomer chinnam dame, litne: chutz mishshomer chinnam vehassocher!
Vei kerabbi yehuda, deamar: socher kenose sachar dame – nitne: "chutz mishshomer chinnam, vechullan bemuadin peturin leinyan kofer"!
Amar rav huna bar chinnana: ha manni – rabbi eliezer hi, deamar: en lo shemira ella sakkin; uleinyan socher savar la kerabbi yehuda, deamar: socher kenose sachar dame.
Abbaye amar: leolam kerabbi meir – vechidmachlif rabba bar avu, vetane: socher ketzad meshallem? rabbi meir omer: keshomer sachar, rabbi yehuda omer: keshomer chinnam.
Amar rabbi elazar: masar shoro leshomer chinnam, hizzik – chayyayv, huzzak – patur.
Amri: hechi dame? i dekabbel aleh shemirat nezakav – afillu huzzak name lichayyev! vei dela kabbel aleh shemirat nezakav – afillu hizzik name lippetar!

Amar rava: leolam shekkibbel alav shemirat nezakav, vehacha bemay askinan – kegon shehikkir bo shehu nagchan. usetama demilleta, dela azel ihu umazzik acharine – kabbel aleh, deate acharine umazzeki leh ledideh – la assek addateh.
Mishna kesharo bealav bemosera venaal befanav karauy, veyatza vehizzik – echad tam veechad muad chayyayv, divre rabbi meir.
Rabbi yehuda omer: tam chayyayv, umuad patur; shenneemar: "velo yishmerennu bealav" – veshamur hu ze.
Rabbi eliezer omer: en lo shemira ella sakkin.

Gemara may tama derabbi meir? kasavar: setam shevorim – lav bechezkat shimmur kayymi; veamar rachamana tam nichayyayv – denive leh shemira pechuta, hadar amar rachamana "velo yishmerennu" gabbe muad – denive leh shemira meulla; veyalef negicha letam – negicha lemuad.

Rabbi yehuda savar: setam shevorim – bechezkat shimmur kayymi; amar rachamana tam neshallem, denive leh shemira meulla; hadar amar rachamana "velo yishmerennu" gabbe muad – denaaved leh shemira meulla. have ribbuy achar ribbuy, veen ribbuy achar ribbuy ella lemaet – miet hakkatuv lishmira meulla.
Vechi tema: negicha letam negicha lemuad – ha miet rachamana "velo yishmerennu" – laze, velo leacher.
Veha mibbee leh lelav! im ken, nichtov rachamana "velo yishmor", may "velo yishmerennu"? laze velo leacher.
Tanya, rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer: echad tam veechad muad sheshshemaro shemira pechuta – patur.
May tama? savar la kerabbi yehuda, deamar: muad – bishmira pechuta saggi leh, veyalef negicha letam unegicha lemuad.
Amar rav adda bar ahava: la patar rabbi yehuda ella tzad haadaa shebbo, aval tzad tammut bimkomah omedet.
Amar rav: muad lekeren yamin – eno muad lekeren semol.

Amri: allibba deman? i allibba derabbi meir, haamar: echad tam veechad muad, shemira meulla bae! i allibba derabbi yehuda, may irya keren semol? afillu beyamin name – it beh tzad tammut, veit beh tzad muadut!
Amri: leolam kerabbi yehuda, vela sevira leh derav adda bar ahava; vehachi kaamar: ki hay gavvna hu demashkachat beh tzad tammut umuadut,

a: Aval muad ligmare – la mashkachat beh tzad tammut kelal.
Rabbi eliezer omer: en lo shemira ella sakkin (kulei). amar rabba: may tama derabbi eliezer? deamar kera: "velo yishmerennu" – shuv en lo shemira laze.
Amar leh abbaye: ella meatta, dichtiv "velo yechassennu" name – shuv en lo kissuy laze?
Vechi tema hachi name, vehatnan: kissahu karauy, venafal letocho shor o chamor umet – patur.

Ella amar abbaye: hayeynu tameh derabbi eliezer – kidtanya, rabbi natan omer: minnayin shello yegaddel adam kelev ra betoch beto, veal yaamid sullam raua betoch beto? shenneemar: "velo tasim damim bevetecha".
Hadaran alach shor shennagach arbaa vachamishsha
Mishna shor shennagach et happara venimtza ubbarah betziddah, veen yadua im ad shello nagcha yalda, im mishshennagcha yalda – meshallem chatzi nezek lappara, urevia nezek lavvalad.
Vechen para shennagcha et hashshor venimtza veladah betziddah, veen yadua im ad shello nagcha yalda, im mishshennagcha yalda – mishtallem chatzi nezek min happara, urevia nezek min havvalad.
Gemara amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: zo divre somchos – deamar: mamon hammuttal besafek – cholkin. aval chachamim omrim: ze kelal gadol baddin, hammotzi mechavero – alav haraya.
Lema li lememar "ze kelal gadol baddin"? itzterich, daafillu nizzak omer bari, umazzik omer shemma – hammotzi mechavero alav haraya.
I name, lechi ha deittemar: hammocher shor lachavero, venimtza nagchan – rav amar: hare ze mikkach taut. ushemuel amar: yachol sheyyomar lo "lishchita mechartiv lach".
Ammay? venichze i gavra dezaven leridya, i gavra dezaven lenichseta! la tzericha, begavra dezaven leha uleha.
Venichze i deme ridya – leridya, i deme nichseta – lenichseta!
La tzericha, deiyyakkayr bisra, vekae bidme ridya.
Amri:
b: Vei lekka leishtallome minneh, lishkeleh letora bezuze! deamri enashe: mimmare rashvotach pare ippera!
La tzericha, deikka leishtallome minneh.

Rav amar hare ze mikkach taut – zil batar rubba, verubba deinashe leridya hu dezavni. ushemuel amar, yachol sheyyomar lo "lishchita mechartiv lach" – vela azlinan batar rubba. ki azlinan batar rubba – beissura, aval bemamona – la azlinan batar rubba, ella hammotzi mechavero alav haraya.

Tanya name hachi: shor shennagach et happara venimtza ubbarah betziddah, veeno yodea im ad shello negachah yalda im mishshennegachah yalda – meshallem chatzi nezek lappara, urevia nezek lavvalad; divre somchos. vachachamim omrim: hammotzi mechavero – alav haraya.
Amar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani: minnayin lehammotzi mechavero alav haraya – shenneemar: "mi vaal devarim yiggash alehem" – yaggish reaya alehem.
Matkef la rav ashe: ha lema li kera? sevara hu – dechaev leh keeva, azel leve asya!

Ella kera lechidrav nachman amar rabba bar avu, deamar rav nachman amar rabba bar avu: minnayin sheen nizkakin ella lattovea techilla? shenneemar: "mi vaal devarim yiggash alehem" – yaggish devarav alehem.
Amri nehardae: peamim shennizkakin lannitba techilla. vehechi dame? deka zili nichseh.
Vechen para shennagcha et hashshor [vechulei]. chatzi nezek urevia nezek?! palga nizka hu devae shallome! kulle nizka neche riva may avidteh?
Amar abbaye: chatzi nezek – echad mearbaa bannezek, urevia nezek – echad mishshemona bannezek.
Vei para uvalad dechad ninhu – hachi name dematze amar leh levaal para: mimma nafshach, chatzi nezek hav li. ella la tzericha, defara dechad, uvalad dechad.
Vei dikdem taveh levaal para techilla – hachi name deamar leh levaal para: para didach azzektan, hav li reaya deit lach shuttafe.
Ella dikdem taveh levaal valad techilla, daamar leh: gallet addatach deshuttafa it li.
Ikka deamri: af al gav dikdem taveh levaal para techilla, matze medache leh – daamar leh: midda yedai ana deshuttafa it li.

Amar rava: attu "echad mearbaa bannezek" veechad mishshemona bannezek" katane? "chatzi nezek" urevia nezek" katane! ella amar rava: leolam befara uvalad dechad, vehachi kaamrinan: ita lefara – mishtallam chatzi nezek mippara.

a: Leta lefara – mishtallem revia nezek mivvalad.
Tama dela yadinan i hava valad bahada ki negacha, i la hava; aval i peshita lan dahava valad bahada ki negacha – mishtallem kulleh chatzi nezek mivvalad;
Rava letameh, deamar rava: para shehizzika – gove mivveladah. may tama? gufa hi. tarnegolet shehizzika – eno gove mibbetzatah. may tama? pirsha bealma hu.
Veamar rava: en shamin lappara bifne atzmah velavvalad bifne atzmo, ella shamin lavvalad al gav para. sheim i atta omer ken – nimtza atta machchish et hammazzik.
Vechen atta motze bekotea yad avdo shel chavero. vechen atta motze bemazzik sade shel chavero.
Amar leh rav acha bereh derava lerav ashe: vei dina hu, lichchosh mazzik!
Mishshum daamar leh: para meabbarta azzektach, para meabbarta shayemna lach.
Peshita, para dechad uvalad dechad – pitma levaal para. nifcha may? rav pappa amar: levaal para, rav acha bereh derav ika amar: cholkin. vehilcheta: cholkin.

Mishna hakkaddar shehichnis kederotav lachatzar baal habbayit shello birshut, veshibberatan behemto shel baal habbayit – patur. veim huzzeka bahen – baal hakkederot chayyayv. veim hichnis birshut – baal hechatzer chayyayv.
Hichnis perotav lachatzar baal habbayit shello birshut, vaachalatan behemto shel baal habbayit – patur. veim huzzeka bahen – baal happerot chayyayv. veim hichnis birshut – baal hechatzer chayyayv.
Hichnis shoro lachatzar baal habbayit shello
b: Birshut, unegacho shoro shel baal habbayit, o shenneshacho kalbo shel baal habbayit – patur. nagach hu shoro shel baal habbayit – chayyayv. nafal levoro, vehivish memav – chayyayv. haya aviv o beno letocho – meshallem et hakkofer. veim hichnis birshut – baal hechatzer chayyayv.
Rabbi omer: bechullan eno chayyayv, ad sheyyekabbel alav lishmor.
Gemara tama deshello birshut, ha birshut – la michayyayv baal kederot benizke vehemto devaal chatzer, vela amrinan kabbole kabbel baal kederot netiruta divhemto devaal chatzer;
Manni – rabbi hi, deamar: kol bistama – la kabbel aleh netiruta.
Ema sefa: im hichnis birshut – baal chatzer chayyayv. atan lerabbanan, deamri: bistama name kabbole kabbel aleh netiruta.
Vetu, rabbi omer: bechullan eno chayyayv, ad sheyyekabbel alav baal habbayit lishmor. resha vesefa rabbi, umetziata rabbanan?!
Amar rabbi zera: tivra; mi sheshshana zo – lo shana zo. rava amar: kulla rabbanan hi, uvirshut – shemirat kederot kibbel alav baal hechatzer, vaafillu nishberu baruach.
Hichnis perotav lachatzar baal habbayit vechulei. amar rav: lo shanu ella shehuchelka bahen, aval achla – patur. may tama? hava la shello tochal.

Amar rav sheshet: amena, ki nayem veshachev rav amar leha shemata. detanya: hannoten sam hammavet lifne behemat chavero – patur middine adam, vechayyayv bedine shamayim. sam hammavet hu dela avida deachla; aval perot, daavida deachla – bedine adam name michayyayv! veammay? havay la shello tochal!
Amri: hu haddin afillu perot – name patur middine adam; veha ka mashma lan – daafillu sam hammavet name, dela avida deachla – chayyayv bedine shamayim.
Veibbaet ema: sam hammavet name – beafrazta, dehayynu pere.
Metivi: haishsha shennichnesa litchon chittim etzel baal habbayit shello birshut, vaachalatan behemto shel baal habbayit – patur. im huzzeka – chayyevet. veammay? nema: hava la shello tochal!
Amri: umi adifa mimmatnitin – deokemna shehuchelka bahen?
Udekaare la may kaare la? amar lach: bishlama matnitin, katane "im huzzeka bahen" – shehuchelka bahen hu; aval hacha, katane "im huzzeka" vela katane "bahen" – achila hu dekatane.
Veiddach amar lach: la shena.
Ta shema: hichnis shoro lachatzar baal habbayit shello birshut, veachal chittin vehitriz vamet – patur. veim hichnis birshut – baal hechatzer chayyayv. veammay? hava leh shello yochal!
Amar rava: birshut ashshello birshut karamet? birshut – shemirat shoro kibbel alav, vaafillu chanak et atzmo.
Ibbaya lehu: hecha dekabbel aleh netiruta, mahu? denafsheh hu dekabbel aleh, o dilma afillu netiruta dealma kabbel aleh?

Ta shema, detane rav yehuda bar simon binzakin deve karna: hichnis perotav lachatzar baal habbayit shello birshut, uva shor mimmakom acher vaachalan – patur. veim hichnis birshut – chayyayv. man patur uman chayyayv? lav patur – baal chatzer, [vechayyayv – baal chatzer]?
Amri: la; patur baal hashshor, vechayyayv baal hashshor.
Vei baal hashshor,

a: May birshut umay shello birshut ikka?
Amri: birshut – havya la shen birshut hannizzak, veshen birshut hannizzak chayyevet. shello birshut – havya la shen birshut harabbim, veshen birshut harabbim petura.

Ta shema: hichnis shoro lachatzar baal habbayit shello birshut, uva shor mimmakom acher unegacho – patur. veim hichnis birshut – chayyayv. man patur uman chayyayv? lav patur baal chatzer, vechayyayv baal chatzer?
La; patur baal hashshor, vechayyayv baal hashshor. i hachi, may birshut umay shello birshut ikka?

Amri: ha manni – rabbi tarfon hi, deamar: meshunne keren bachatzar hannizzak – nezek shalem meshallem. birshut – havya la keren bachatzar hannizzak, umeshallem nezek shalem; shello birshut – havya la keren birshut harabbim, vela meshallema ella chatzi nezek.
Hahi itteta dealla lemefa behahu beta, ata barcha demare deveta achle lelesha, chavil umit. chayyeyva rava leshallome deme varcha.
Lema peliga adderav – deamar rav: havay la shello tochal?
Amri: hachi hasheta?! hatam shello birshut – la kabbel aleh netiruta, hacha birshut – kabbel aleh netiruta.

Umay shena mehaishsha shennichnesa litchon chittin etzel baal habbayit shello birshut, vaachalatan behemto shel baal habbayit – patur, veim huzzeka – chayyevet; tama shello birshut, ha birshut – petura[5]!

Amri: litchon chittim, kevan dela baaya tzeniuta midde – la (bae) mesalleki maravota dechatzer nafshayyhu, vaaleh dideh rame netiruta; aval lemefa, kevan devaaya hi tzeniuta – maravota dechatzer mesalleki nafshayyhu, hilkach ala dida ramya netiruta.

Hichnis shoro lachatzar baal habbayit. amar rava: hichnis shoro lachatzar baal habbayit shello birshut, vechafar bah borot shichin umearot – baal hashshor chayyayv benizke chatzer, uvaal chatzer chayyayv benizke habbor.
Af al gav deamar mar: "ki yichre ish bor" – velo shor bor; hacha, kevan deit leh lehaych lemalloyeh, vela ka malleyeh – keman decharyeh dame.
Veamar rava: hichnis shoro lachatzar baal habbayit shello birshut, vehizzik et baal habbayit, o baal habbayit huzzak bo – chayyayv. ravatz – patur.
Umishshum deravatz, patur? amar rav pappa: may "ravatz" – shehirbitz gelalim, venitnefu kelav shel baal habbayit; dehave gelalim bor, velo matzinu bor shechiyyev bo et hakkelim.
Hanicha lishmuel, deamar: kol takkala – bor hu. ella lerav, deamar: ad demafkar leh, may ikka lememar?
Amri: setam gelalim – afkore mafkayr lehu.
Veamar rava: nichnas lachatzar baal habbayit shello birshut, vehizzik et baal habbayit o baal habbayit huzzak bo – chayyayv. hizziko baal habbayit – patur.
Amar rav pappa: la amaran – ella dela hava yada beh; aval hava yada beh – hizziko baal habbayit, chayyayv. may tama? mishshum deamar leh: nehi deit lach reshuta leappoke, leazzoke let lach reshuta.
Veazdu letamayyhu, deamar rava veittema rav pappa:
b: Shenehem birshut o shenehem shello birshut, hizziku ze et ze – chayyayvin. huzzeku ze baze – peturin. tama dishnehem birshut o shenehem shello birshut; aval echad birshut veechad shello birshut, devirshut – patur, shello birshut – chayyayv.

Nafal levor vehivish memav – chayyayv. amar rava: lo shanu ella shehivish bishat nefila, aval leachar nefila – patur. may tama? have shor "bor" umayim "kelim", velo matzinu bor shechiyyev bo et hakkelim.
Hanicha lishmuel, deamar: kol takkala – bor hu. ella lerav, deamar: ad demafkar leh, may ikka lememar?
Ella i ittemar – hachi ittemar, amar rava: lo shanu ella shehivish miggufo, aval hivish merecho – patur. may tama? gerama bealma hu, ugerama bealma la michayyayv.
Haya aviv o beno letocho – meshallem et hakkofer. veammay? ha tam hu! amar rav: bemuad lippol al bene adam bevorot askinan.
I hachi, bar ketala hu! amar rav yosef: dachaza yeroka unefal.
Shemuel amar: ha manni – rabbi yose haggelili hi, deamar: tam meshallem chatzi kofer.
Ulla amar: rabbi yose haggelili hi – deamar kerabbi tarfon, deamar: keren bachatzar hannizzak – nezek shalem meshallem. hachi name, kofer shalem meshallem.
Bishlama leulla, hayeynu dekatane: haya aviv o beno letocho. ella lishmuel, may irya aviv o beno? afillu acher name!
Orcheh demilleta katane.
Veim hichnis birshut – baal chatzer chayyayv [kulei]. ittemar, rav amar: hilcheta ketanna kamma, ushemuel amar: hilcheta kerabbi.
Tanu rabbanan: "kenos shorcha veshomro" – hizzik chayyayv, huzzak patur. "kenos shorcha vaani eshmerennu" – huzzak chayyayv, hizzik patur.
Ha gufa kashya – amrat: "kenos shorcha veshomro" – hizzik chayyayv, huzzak patur;
Tama daamar leh "shomro" dechayyayv baal hashshor ufatur baal chatzer, ha setama – chayyayv baal chatzer ufatur baal hashshor, devistama mekabbel aleh netiruta.
Ema sefa: "kenos shorcha vaani eshmerennu" – huzzak chayyayv, hizzik patur.
Tama daamar leh "vaani eshmerennu" hu dimchayyev baal hechatzer ufatur baal hashshor, ha setama – chayyayv baal hashshor ufatur baal chatzer, devistama la mekabbel aleh netiruta;
Atan lerabbi, deamar: ad sheyyekabbel aleh netiruta baal habbayit lishmor. resha rabbanan vesefa rabbi?!
Amar rabbi elazar: tavra, mi sheshshana zo lo shana zo. rava amar: kulla rabbanan hi, ayyeyde denasev resha "shomro", tena sefa "vaani eshmerennu".
Rav pappa amar: kulla rabbi hi; vesavar la kerabbi tarfon, deamar: keren bachatzar hannizzak – nezek shalem meshallem.
Hilkach, amar leh "shomro" – la makne leh makom bechatzer, vehavya lay keren bachatzar hannizzak, vekeren bachatzar hannizzak meshallem nezek shalem.
La amar leh "shomro" – aknoye akni leh makom bechatzer, vehavya leh chatzar hashshuttafin, vekeren bachatzar hashshuttafin eno meshallem ella chatzi nezek.
Mishna shor shehaya mitkavven lachavero, vehikka et haishsha veyatzu yeladeha – patur middeme veladot. veadam shehaya mitkavven lachavero, vehikka haishsha veyatzu yeladeha – meshallem deme veladot.
Ketzad meshallem deme veladot? shamin haishsha kamma hi yafa ad shello yalada, vechamma hi yafa mishsheyyalada. amar rabban shimon ben gamliel:

a: Im ken, mishshehaishshe yoledet mashbachat! ella shamin et havveladot kamma hen yafin, venoten labbaal. veim en la baal – noten leyorshav.
Hayta shifcha venishtachrera, o giyyoret – patur.

Gemara tama demitkavven lachavero, ha mitkavven laishsha – meshallem deme veladot. lema tehve teyuveta derav adda bar ahava – deamar rav adda bar ahava: shevorim shennitkavvevnu laishsha – peturim middeme veladot?

Amar lecha rav adda bar ahava: hu haddin daafillu nitkavvevnu laishsha name peturim middeme veladot; veha dekatane: "shor shehaya mitkavven lachavero" – ayyeyde deka bae lemitna sefa: "adam shehaya mitkavven lachavero" – dehachi ketiv kera, katane resha name: "shor shehaya mitkavven lachavero".

Amar rav pappa: shor shennagach et hashshifcha, veyatzu yeladeha – meshallem deme veladot. may tama? chamarta meabbarta bealma hu deazzek, deamar kera: "shevu lachem po im hachamor" – am haddome lachamor.

Ketzad meshallem deme veladot. "deme veladot"?! "shevach veladot" mibbee leh! hachi name kaamar: ketzad meshallem deme veladot ushevach veladot – shamin et haishsha kamma hi yafa ad shello yalada, vechamma hi yafa mishsheyyalada.

Amar rabban shimon ben gamliel: im ken, mishshehaishshe yoledet mashbachat! may kaamar? amar rabba, hachi kaamar: vechi ishsha mashbachat kodem shetteled yoter milleachar shetteled? vahalo ishsha mashbachat leachar shetteled yoter mikkodem shetteled! ella shamin et havveladot, venotnin labbaal.
Tanya name hachi: vechi ishsha mashbachat kodem shetteled yoter milleachar shetteled? vahalo ishsha mashbachat leachar shetteled yoter mikkodem shetteled! ella shamin et havveladot venotnin labbaal.
Rava amar, hachi katane: vechi ishsha – lemi sheyyoledet mashbachat, veen leatzmah bishvach veladot kelum? ella shamin et havveladot venotnin labbaal, ushevach veladot cholkin.

Tanya name hachi, amar rabban shimon ben gamliel: vechi ishsha – lemi sheyyoledet mashbachat, veen leatzmah bishvach veladot kelum? ella shamin nezek bifne atzmo, vetzaar bifne atzmo; veshamin et havveladot venotnin labbaal, ushevach veladot cholkin.
Kashya derabban shimon ben gamliel adderabban shimon ben gamliel!
La kashya; kan bimvakkeret, kan besheenah mevakkeret.
Verabbanan deamri shevach veladot name labbaal – may tama? keditnan, mimmashma shenneemar: "veyatzu yeladeha" – eni yodea shehi hara? ma talmud lomar: "hara"? lomar lach: shevach herayon labbaal.

Verabban shimon ben gamliel, hay "hara" may daresh beh? mibbee leh lechidtanya, rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer: leolam eno chayyayv, ad sheyyakkenna keneged bet haherayon. amar rav pappa: la tema keneged bet herayon mammash, ella kol hecha desalek beh shichma levalad. leappoke yad varegel – dela.

Hayta shifcha venishtachrera, o giyyoret – patur. amar rabba: lo shanu ella shechaval bah bechayye hagger, umet hagger; dechevan dechaval bah bechayye hagger – zecha behu ger, vechevan demet hagger – zecha behu min hagger. aval chaval bah leachar mitat hagger – zachya la ihi begavvayyhu, umichayyayv leshallome la ledida.
Amar rav chisda: mare dechi! attu veladot tzerare ninhu – vezachya behu?! ella iteh levaal – zecha leh rachamana, leteh levaal – la.

Metivi: hikka et haishsha, veyatzu yeladeha – noten nezek vatzaar laishsha, udeme veladot labbaal. en habbaal – noten leyorshav, en haishsha – noten leyorsheha. hayta shifcha venishtachrera, o giyyoret – zacha!
Amri: umi adifa mimmatnitin – deokemna shechaval bah bechayye hagger, umet hagger? hacha name – shechaval bah bechayye hagger, umet hagger. veibbaet ema: leachar mitat hagger,
b: Uteni: "zachta".

Lema ketannae: bat yisrael shennisset leger venitabbera mimmennu, vechaval bah; bechayye hagger – noten deme veladot lagger. leachar mitat hagger – tane chada: chayyayv, vetane chada: patur. may, lav tannae ninhu? lerabba – vadday tannae hi. ella lerav chisda – mi lema tannae hi?
La kashya; ha rabbanan, ha rabban shimon ben gamliel.
I rabban shimon ben gamliel, may irya leachar mita? afillu mechayyim name it la palga! mechayyim it la palga, leachar mita kulleh.
Veibbaet ema: ha veha rabban shimon ben gamliel; kan bishvach veladot, kan bidme veladot.
Amri: mishshevach veladot lishma deme veladot, umerabban shimon ben gamliel lishma lerabbanan!
Amri: la; shevach veladot, deshayycha yeda begavvayyhu – zachya behu bechullehu; deme veladot, la shayycha yeda begavvayyhu – la zachya behu kelal.

Bae minneh rav yeva sava merav nachman: hammachzik bishtarotav shel ger, mahu? man demachzek bishtara – addata deara hu machzek, uveara ha la achzek; ushetara name la kena – delav dateh ashshetara; o dilma, dateh name ashshetara?
Amar leh: anay mori, vechi latzor al pi tzelochito hu tzarich? amar leh: latzor velatzor.
Amar rabba: mashkono shel yisrael beyad ger, umet hagger, uva yisrael acher vehechzik bo – motziin oto miyyado. may tama? kevan demit leh ger – peka leh shibudeh.
Mashkono shel ger beyad yisrael, umet hagger, uva yisrael acher vehechezik bo – ze kana keneged meotav, veze kana et hashshear.
Veammay? tikne leh chatzero – dehaamar rabbi yose bar chanina: chatzero shel adam kona lo shello middato!

Amri: hacha bemay askinan – deleteh. kol hecha deite ledideh, dei bae mikne [matze] kane – kanya leh [name] chatzero; kol hecha deleteh ledideh, dei bae hu lemikne la matze kane – chatzero name la kanya.
Vehilcheta: deleteh bachatzero – delo kana.
Mishna hachofer bor birshut hayyachid ufetacho lirshut harabbim, o birshut harabbim ufetacho lirshut hayyachid, birshut hayyachid ufetacho lirshut hayyachid acher – chayyayv.

Gemara tanu rabbanan: hachofer bor birshut hayyachid ufetacho lirshut harabbim; birshut harabbim ufetacho lirshut hayyachid – chayyayv, vezehu bor haamur battora; divre rabbi yishmael. rabbi akiva omer: hifkir reshuto velo hifkir boro – zehu bor haamur battora.

Amar rabba: bevor birshut harabbim – kulle alma la peligi demichayyayv, may tama? amar kera: "ki yiftach" vechi yichre" – im al peticha chayyayv, al keriyyay lo kol shekken?! ella sheal iske peticha veal iske keriyyay baa lo. lo nechleku ella

a: Bevor birshuto – rabbi akiva savar: bor birshuto name chayyayv, dichtiv: "baal habbor" – bevor deit leh bealim kaamar rachamana,
Verabbi yishmael savar: baal hattakkala.
Ella may "zehu bor haamur battora" dekaamar rabbi akiva? zehu bor sheppatach bo hakkatuv techilla letashlumin.
Verav yosef amar: bevor birshut hayyachid – kulle alma la peligi demichayyayv, may tama? "baal habbor" amar rachamana – bevor deit leh bealim askinan.

Ki peligi – bevor birshut harabbim; rabbi yishmael savar: bor birshut harabbim name chayyayv, dichtiv "ki yiftach" vechi yichre" – im al peticha chayyayv, al keriyyay lo kol shekken? ella sheal iske feticha veal iske cheriyyay baa lo.
Verabbi akiva – hanhu mitzrach tzerichi; dei ketav rachamana "ki yiftach" – hava amena: poteach hu desaggi leh bechissuy, kore la saggi leh bechissuy ad detaem leh.
Vei ketav rachamana "ki yichre" – hava amena: keriyyay hu devae kissuy, mishshum daavad maase; aval poteach – dela avad maase, ema kissuy name la bae; ka mashma lan.
Veella may "zehu bor haamur battora" dekaamar rabbi yishmael? zehu bor sheppatach bo hakkatuv techilla linzakin.
Metivi: hachofer bor birshut harabbim, ufetacho lirshut hayyachid – patur; veaf al pi sheeno rashshay laasot ken, lefi sheen osin chalal tachat reshut harabbim.

Hachofer borot, shichin umearot birshut hayyachid, ufetacho lirshut harabbim – chayyayv. vehachofer borot birshut hayyachid hassemucha lirshut harabbim, kegon ellu hachofrim leushshin – patur. verabbi yose berabbi yehuda mechayyev ad sheyyaase mechitza asara, o ad sheyyarchik mimmekom derisat ragle adam umimmekom derisat ragle vehema – arbaa tefachim.
Tama dilushshin, ha lav leushshin – chayyayv;
Ha manni? bishlama lerabba – resha rabbi yishmael, vesefa rabbi akiva.
Ella lerav yosef, bishlama sefa – divre hakkol; ella resha manni? la rabbi yishmael, vela rabbi akiva!
Amar lecha rav yosef: kulla divre hakkol hi, veresha – shello hifkir lo reshuto velo boro.
Amar rav ashe: hasheta deokemta lerav yosef ledivre hakkol, lerabba name la tokma ketannae –
Midderesha rabbi yishmael, sefa name rabbi yishmael; vetama dilushshin, ha lav leushshin chayyayv – kegon dearvavch arvoche lirshut harabbim.

Metivi: hachofer bor birshut hayyachid, ufetacho lirshut harabbim – chayyayv. birshut hayyachid hassemucha lirshut harabbim – patur. bishlama lerabba, kulla rabbi yishmael hi. ella lerav yosef, bishlama resha – rabbi yishmael, ella sefa manni? la rabbi yishmael vela rabbi akiva!
Amar lach: bechofer leushshin, vedivre hakkol.

Tanu rabbanan: chafar ufatach umasar larabbim – patur. chafar ufatach velo masar larabbim – chayyayv, vechen minhago shel nechuneya chofer borot shichin umearot, shehaya chofer ufoteach umoser larabbim. uchesheshshamu chachamim baddavar, amru: kiyyem ze halacha zo. halacha zo vetu la?! ella ema: af halacha zo.

Tanu rabbanan: maase bevitto shel nechuneya chofer shichin shennafla levor gadol, bau vehodiu et rabbi chanina ben dosa. shaa rishona amar lahem: shalom. sheniyya amar lahem: shalom. shelishit amar lahem: alta.

Amru lah: mi heelich? amra lahem: zachar shel rechelim nizdammen li, vezaken echad manhigo. amru lo: navi atta? amar lahem: "lo navi anochi, velo ben navi anochi", ella kach amarti: davar sheoto tzaddik mitztaer bo – yikkashel bo zaro?

Amar rabbi acha: af al pi chen, met beno batztzama. shenneemar: "usevivav nisara meod" – melammed shehakkadosh baruch hu medakdek im sevivav afillu kechut hassaara. rabbi nechuneya amar mehacha: "el naaratz besod kedoshim rabba, venora al kol sevivav".

Amar rabbi chanina: kol haomer hakkadosh baruch hu vatteran hu, yivvatru chayyav, shenneemar: "hatztzur tamim poolo, ki chol derachav mishpat". amar rabbi chana veittema rabbi shemuel bar nachmani, may dichtiv:
b: "Erech appayim" – vela ketiv "erech af"? erech appayim latztzaddikim velarshaim.

Tanu rabbanan: lo yesakkel adam mershuto lirshut harabbim. maase beadam echad shehaya mesakkel mershuto lirshut harabbim, umetzao chasid echad. amar lo: reka, mippene ma atta mesakkel mershut sheenah shellach lirshut shellach? ligleg alav.
Leyamim nitzrach limkor sadehu, vehaya mehallech beoto reshut harabbim, venichshal beotan avanim; amar: yafe amar li oto chasid – mippene ma atta mesakkel mershut sheenah shellach lirshut shellach.

Mishna hachofer bor birshut harabbim, venafal letocho shor o chamor – chayyayv. echad hachofer bor, shiach umeara, charitzin uneitzin – chayyayv. im ken lamma neemar "bor"? ma bor sheyyesh bo kede lehamit – asara tefachim; af kol sheyyesh bo kede lehamit – asara tefachim. hayu pechutin measara tefachim, venafal letocho shor o chamor, umet – patur. veim huzzak bo – chayyayv.
Gemara amar rav: bor shechiyyeyva alav tora – lehevlo, velo lachavato. alma kasavar: chavata – karka olam hu demazzeka leh.
Ushemuel amar: lehevlo, vechol shekken lachavato. veim tomar: lachavato amra tora, velo lehevlo – hattora heida al habbor, vaafillu male sefogin shel tzemer.
May benayyhu? ikka benayyhu daavad gova birshut harabbim; lerav – aggova la michayyayv, lishmuel – aggova name michayyayv.
May tama derav? deamar kera: "venafal" – ad sheyyippol derech nefila. velishmuel, "venafal" – kol dehu mashma.

Tenan: im ken lamma neemar "bor"? ma bor sheyyesh bo kede lehamit – asara tefachim, af kol sheyyesh bo kede lehamit – asara tefachim. bishlama lishmuel – "af kol" leetoye gova. ella lerav – "af kol" leetoye may?
Leetoye charitzin uneitzin. charitzin uneitzin behedya katane lehu! tane, vahadar mefaresh.
Vehane kullehu dekatane – lema li? tzericha; dei tena bor, hava amena: bor asara – hu deit beh havela, mishshum dekattin uchericha; aval shiach – daarich, ema: baasara let beh havela.
Vei tena shiach, hava amena: shiach asara hu deit beh havela, mishshum dekattin; aval meara – dimrabbea, ema: baasara let ba havela.
Vei tane meara, hava amena: meara baasara hu deit ba havela, mishshum dimtallela; aval charitzin – dela metalleli, ema: baasara let behu havela.

Vei tena charitzin, hava amena: charitzin asara hu deit behu havela, mishshum delet behu revicha milleel tefe mittattay; aval neitzin – dirvichi milleel tefe mittattay, ema baasara let behu havela; ka mashma lan.
Tenan: hayu pechutin measara tefachim, venafal letocho shor o chamor, vamet – patur. veim huzzak bo – chayyayv. nafal letocho shor o chamor, umet – patur; may tama – lav mishshum delet beh chavta?
La, mishshum delet beh havela. i hachi, im huzzak bo chayyayv? ha let beh havela! amri: en havela lemita, veyesh havela linzakin.
Hahu tora dinfal laaritta dedallae, shachteh mareh. tarfeh rav nachman.

Amar rav nachman: i shekel mareh dehay tora kabba dekimcha, vaazal tena be midresha: im shahata meet leet – keshera; la afsedeh letora deshave kamma kabbe. alma kasavar rav nachman: yesh chavata befachot measara.
Etiveh rava lerav nachman: hayu pechutin measara tefachim, venafal letocho shor o chamor, umet – patur. may tama? lav mishshum delet beh chavta?

a: La, mishshum delet beh havela. i hachi, huzzak bo chayyayv? ha let beh havela! amar leh: en hevel lemita, veyesh hevel linzakin.
Etiveh: bet hassekila haya gavoah shete komot. vetane ala: vekoma shello – hare kan shalosh. vei salka datach yesh chavata befachot measara, lema li kulle hay?
Uletamaych – naaved asara! ella kerav nachman – deamar rav nachman amar rabba bar avu, amar kera: "veahavta lereacha kamocha" – beror lo mita yafa.
I hachi, nagba tefe! mishshum deminnavvavl.
Etiveh: "ki yippol hannofel mimmennu"; "mimmennu" – velo betocho.
Ketzad? hayta reshut harabbim gavoah mimmennu asara tefachim, venafal mittochah letocho – patur. amukka mimmennu asara tefachim, venafal mittocho letochah – chayyayv.
Vei salka datach yesh chavata befachot measara, lema li asara? amar leh: shane bayit, dechol pachot measara – lav bayit hu.
I hachi, hasheta name dehave meabbaray asara, dal minneh tikra umaaziva – miggavvay la have asara! amar leh: kegon dechak miggavvay.
I hachi, ki la have name meabbaray asara – mashkachat la dehave miggavvay asara kegon dechak ba tefe!
Ella hayeynu tama derav nachman, savar: mikkeresa detora leara kamma have – arbea; aritta dedallae kamma have – shitta; ha asra. ishtechach dechi ka michavat – measara hu deka michavat.
Ella matnitin dekatane: ma bor shehu kede lehamit – asara tefachim, af kol sheyyesh bo kede lehamit – asara tefachim; beshitta name sagya!
Amri: matnitin – deiggandar levor.
Mishna bor shel shene shuttafin; avar alav harishon velo kissahu, vehashsheni velo kissahu – hashsheni chayyayv.

Gemara amri: bor shel shene shuttafin hechi mashkachat la? hanicha i sevira lan kerabbi akiva, deamar: bor birshuto – chayyayv; mashkachat la bechatzer shel shenehem uvor shel shenehem, vehifkiru reshutan velo hifkiru boran.
Ella i sevira lan bor birshuto patur; hechi mashkachat la dechayyayv aleh – birshut harabbim, uvirshut harabbim bor shel shene shuttafin hechi mashkachat la?
I deshauo shaliach tarvayyhu, veamri leh: "zil keri lan", vaazal kera lehu – en shaliach lidvar avera! vei dichra hay chamsha vehay chamsha – nistalleku lehu maase rishon!
Hanicha lerabbi – velinzakin, mashkachat la. ella lerabbi – ulemita, ulerabbanan – ben lemita ben linzakin; hechi mashkachat la?
Amar rabbi yochanan: kegon sheakru shenehen chuleya bevat achat, vehishlimu laasara.
May rabbi umay rabbanan? detanya: echad hachofer bor tisha, uva acher vehishlimah laasara – haacharon chayyayv. rabbi omer: achar acharon lemita, veachar shenehem linzakin.
May tama derabbanan? deamar kera: "ki yiftach" vechi yichre" – im al peticha chayyayv, al keriyyay lo kol shekken? ella lehavi kore achar kore, shessillek maase rishon.
Verabbi amar lach: hanhu mitzrach tzerichi, kidamrinan. verabbanan name mitzrach tzerichi!
Ella hayeynu tama derabbanan – amar kera: "ki yichre ish bor" – echad velo shenayim.
Verabbi – hahu mibbee leh: "ki yichre ish bor" – velo shor bor.
Verabbanan – tere "ish bor" ketivi.
Verabbi – ayyeyde dichtav hay, ketav hay.
Umimmay dilchayyove batra? dilma lechayyove kamma!
La salka datach, deamar kera: "vehammet yihye lo" – hahu deka aved mita.
Vehay "vehammet yihye lo" mibbee leh lechidrava – deamar rava: shor pesule hammukedashin shennafal levor – patur, shenneemar: "vehammet yihye lo" – bemi shehammet shello!
Amri: velav mimmela shamat minna, divhahu daavad mita askinan?

Tanu rabbanan: echad hachofer bor asara, uva acher vehishlimah leesrim, uva acher vehishlimah lishloshim – kullan chayyayvin. ureminhu: echad hachofer bor asara, uva acher vesiyyed vechiyyed – haacharon chayyayv.
b: Lema ha rabbi, veha rabbanan?
Amar rav zevid: ha veha rabbanan; ad kan la kaamri rabbanan acharon chayyayv, ella hecha dela avad kamma shiur mita; aval hecha daavad kamma shiur mita – afillu rabbanan modu dechullan chayyayvin.
Veha siyyed vechiyyed, deka avad kamma shiur mita, vekatane: acharon chayyayv! amri: hatam – shello haya bo hevel lemita, uva acher vehosif bah hevel lemita.

Ikka deamri, amar rav zevid: ha veha rabbi; hach dekatane: kullan chayyayvin – shappir; ha dekatane: acharon chayyayv – kegon shello haya bo hevel lo lemita velo linzakin, uva acher vehosif bo hevel ben lemita ben linzakin.
Amar rava: hinniach even al pi habbor, vehishlimah laasara – banu lemachloket rabbi verabbanan.
Peshita! mahu detema, lematta hu dehavla dideh ka katel leh, aval lemala – dela havela dideh ka katel, ema la; ka mashma lan.
Bae rava: tam tefach, vesillek avanav, mahu? mi amrinan: may daavad – shakleh;
O dilma, nistalleku maase rishon, vekama lay kullay birshuteh? teku.
Amar rabba bar bar chana amar shemuel bar marta: bor shemona, umehen shene tefachim mayim – chayyayv. may tama? kol tefach demayya – kitre deyabbasha dame.
Ibbaya lehu: bor tisha umehen tefach echad mayim, mahu? mi amrinan kevan dela nefishi mayya – let beh havela; o dilma, kevan deammik tefe – it beh havela?
Bor shiva, umehen shelosha tefachim mayim, mahu? mi amrinan kevan dinfishi mayim tefe – it beh havela; o dilma, kevan dela ammika – let beh havela? teku.
Bea minneh rav shezvi merabba: hirchivah mahu? amar leh: hare miet havela. amar leh: adderabba, hare kerav hezzeka!

Ella amar rav ashe: nichze anan; i behavela miyt – hare miet havela, i bechavta miyt – hare kerav hezzeka. ikka deamri, amar rav ashe: nichze anan; i mehahi gisa nefal – hare kerav hezzeka, vei meiddach gisa nefal – hare miet havela.

Ittemar: bor sheomkah kerochbah – rabba verav yosef deamri tarvayyhu mishshemeh derabba bar bar chana, deamar mishshemeh derabbi mani – chad amar: leolam yesh bah hevel, ad sheyyehe rochbah yater al omkah; vechad amar: leolam en bah hevel, ad sheyyehe omkah yater al rochbah.

Avar alav harishon velo kissahu. verishon meemat mippetar? rabba verav yosef deamri tarvayyhu mishshemeh derabba bar bar chana, deamar mishshemeh derabbi mani – chad amar: mishshemmannicho mishtammesh, vechad amar: mishsheyyimsor lo dolyo.
Ketannae: hamedalle mayim min habbor, uva chavero veamar lo: hannach li, vaani adalle mayim; kevan shehinnicho mishtammesh – patur. rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer: mishsheyyimsor lo dolyo.
Bemay kamippalgi? rabbi eliezer ben yaakov savar: yesh berera –
Hay middideh ka memalle, vehay middideh ka memalle. verabbanan savri: en berera.
Amar ravina: veazdu letamayyhu, ditnan: hashshuttafin shennadru hanaa ze mizze – asurin likkanes lechatzer. rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer: ze nichnas letoch shello, veze nichnas letoch shello.
Bemay kamippalgi? rabbi eliezer ben yaakov savar: yesh berera – hay lidnafsheh ayel, vehay lidnafsheh ayel. verabbanan savri: en berera.
Amar rabbi elazar: hammocher bor lachavero, kevan shemmasar lo dolyo – kana. hechi dame? i bechaspa – likne bechaspa! i bachazaka – likne bachazaka!
Leolam bachazaka, uvae lememar leh: "lech chazek ukene"; vechevan shemmasar lo dolyo, keman daamar leh "lech chazek ukene" dame.
Amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: hammocher bayit lachavero,

a: Kevan shemmasar lo mafteach – kana.

Hechi dame? i bechaspa – likne bechaspa! i bachazaka – likne bachazaka! leolam bachazaka, uvae lememar leh "lech chazek ukene"; vechevan shemmasar lo mafteach, keman daamar leh "lech chazek ukene" dame.
Amar resh lakish mishshum rabbi yannay: hammocher eder lachavero, kevan shemmasar lo mashkuchit – kana.

Hechi dame? i bimshicha – likne bimshicha! i bimsira – likne bimsira! leolam bimshicha, uvae lememar leh: "lech meshoch ukene", vechevan demasar lo mashkuchit – keman deamar leh: "lech meshoch ukene" dame.
May mashkuchit? hacha targimu: karkashta. rabbi yaakov omer: izza deazla beresh edra – kedidrash hahu galilaa aleh derav chisda: kad ragez raaya al ana, aved lenaggada samvata.

Mishna kissahu harishon, uva hashsheni umetzao megulle, velo kissahu – hashsheni chayyayv. kissahu karauy, venafal letocho shor o chamor, vamet – patur. lo kissahu karauy, venafal letocho shor o chamor, vamet – chayyayv.
Nafal lefanav mikkol hakkeriyyay – chayyayv, leacharav mikkol hakkeriyyay – patur.
Nafal letocho shor vechelav – venishtabberu, chamor vechelav – venitkaru; chayyayv al habbehema, ufatur al hakkelim.
Nafal letocho shor cheresh shote vekatan – chayyayv. ben o bat, eved o ama – patur.
Gemara verishon ad emat mippetar? amar rav: bichde sheyyeda. ushemuel amar: bichde sheyyodiuhu. verabbi yochanan amar: bichdi sheyyodiuhu, veyiskor poalim, veyichrot arazim vichassennu.
Kissahu karauy, venafal letocho shor o chamor, vamet – patur. kevan dechissahu karauy, hechi nefal? amar rabbi yitzchak bar bar chana: shehitlia mittocho.

Ibbaya lehu: kissahu kissuy sheyyachol laamod lifne shevorim, veen yachol laamod bifne gemallim; vaato gemallim vearu, veatu shevorim venafli beh – may? amri: hechi dame? i dishchichi gemallim – poshea hu! vei dela shechichi gemallim – anus hu!
La tzericha, daato lifrakim; mi amrinan kevan deatayin lifrakim – poshea hu, deibbei leh assoke addateh; o dilma, kevan dehashta mihat lekka – anus hu?
Ta shema: kissahu karauy, venafal letocho shor o chamor, vamet – patur. hechi dame? illema karauy lishvorim vecharauy ligmallim – hechi neful? ella lav karauy lishvorim,
b: Velo karauy ligmallim? vei dishchichi gemallim, ammay patur? poshea hu! vei dela shechichi gemallim – peshita, anus hu! ella lav deatayin lifrakim, vaato gemallim vearu, vaato shevorim unefalu beh – vekatane patur? alma, kevan dehashta lekka – anus hu!
Amri: la, leolam karauy lishvorim vecharauy ligmallim; udeka kashya lach – hechi neful? amar rabbi yitzchak bar bar chana: shehitlia mittocho.

Ta shema: lo kissahu karauy, venafal letocho shor o chamor, vamet – chayyayv. hechi dame? illema lo karauy lishvorim velo karauy ligmallim, peshita – tzericha lememar dechayyayv?! ella lav karauy lishvorim velo karauy ligmallim? hechi dame? i dishchichi gemallim – poshea hu! vei dela shechichi gemallim – anus hu!
Ella lav deatayin lifrakim, vaato gemallim vearu, vaato shevorim unefalu beh – vekatane chayyayv? alma kevan deatayin lifrakim – poshea hu, deibbei leh assoke addateh!
Leolam karauy lishvorim velo karauy ligmallim, ushechichi gemallim; udeka kashya lach – poshea hu! ayyeyde dinsev resha "kissahu karauy", nesev sefa name "lo kissahu karauy".
Ikka deamri: ha name vadday la ibbaya lan; dechevan deatayin lifrakim – poshea hu, deibbei leh assoke addateh;

Ki ibbei lan – hachi hu deibbaya lan: kissahu kissuy sheyyachol laamod bifne shevorim veeno yachol laamod bifne gemallim, ushechichi gemallim; vehitlia mittocho – mahu? mi amrinan: miggo dehave poshea etzel gemallim, have poshea name leinyan hatelaa; o dilma la amrinan miggo?

Ta shema: kissahu karauy, venafal letocho shor o chamor, vamet – patur. veittemar ala, amar rabbi yitzchak bar bar chana: shehitlia mittocho. hechi dame? illema karauy lishvorim vecharauy ligmallim, vehitlia mittocho – peshita defatur, may hava leh lemebad?
Ella lav karauy lishvorim velo karauy ligmallim, ushechichi gemallim, vehitlia mittocho – vekatane patur? alma la amrinan miggo dehave poshea leinyan gemallim have poshea leinyan hatelaa!
La; leolam karauy ligmallim ucherauy lishvorim, vehitlia mittocho. udeka kashya lach – ki hitlia may hava leh lemebad? mahu detema: ibbei leh lemezal uminkash aleh; ka mashma lan.
Ta shema: lo kissahu karauy, venafal letocho shor o chamor, vamet – chayyayv. hechi dame? illema lo karauy lishvorim velo karauy ligmallim – tzericha lememar dechayyayv?

Ella lav karauy lishvorim velo karauy ligmallim? vei dishchichi gemallim – poshea hu, vei dela shechichi gemallim – anus hu! ella lav dishchichi gemallim, vehitlia mittocho – vekatane chayyayv? alma amrinan miggo dehave poshea leinyan gemallim – have poshea leinyan hatelaa!

Amri: la; leolam karauy lishvorim velo karauy ligmallim, ushechichi gemallim; vaato gemallim vearu, vaato shevorim unefalu beh. udeka kashya lach – peshita, poshea hu! ayyeyde dinsev resha "kissahu karauy", nesev sefa name "lo kissahu".

Ta shema: nafal letocho shor cheresh, shote vekatan, some umehallech ballayla – chayyayv. pikkeach umehallech bayyom – patur. veammay? nema middehave poshea leinyan cheresh, have name poshea leinyan pikkeach! ella lav shema minna – la amrinan miggo? shema minna.
Nafal lefanav kulei. amar rav: "lefanav" – lefanav mammash, "leacharav" – acharav mammash.

a: Veze vaze bevor.
Rav letameh – deamar rav: bor shechiyyeyva alav tora – lehevlo, velo lachavato.
Ushemuel amar: bevor – ben millefanav ben milleacharav, chayyayv.
Shemuel letameh, deamar: lehevlo – vechol shekken lachavato. ella hechi dame leacharav mikkol hakkeriyyay – defatur? kegon denitkal babbor, venafal laachore habbor chutz labbor.
Etiveh: bevor – ben lefanav ben leacharav, chayyayv. teyuveta derav!
Amar rav chisda: mode rav bevor birshuto – dechayyayv, mishshum deamar leh: mimma nafshach? i behavela mit – havela didach hu, i bechavta mit – chavta didach hu.
Rabba amar: hacha bemay askinan – bemithappech, dinfal aappeh veithafich unefal aggabbeh; dehavla deahani beh, ahani beh.
Rav yosef amar: hacha benizke vor beshor askinan – may nihu? shehivish et memav; dela shena lefanav vela shena leacharav – michayyayv.
Tane rav chananya lesayyoe lerav: "venafal" – ad sheyyippol derech nefila. mikkan amru: nafal lefanav mikkol hakkeriyyay – chayyayv, leacharav mikkol hakkeriyyay – patur. veze vaze bevor.

Amar mar: nafal lefanav mikkol hakkeriyyay – chayyayv. veammay? nema kore geram leh! amar rav shimi bar ashe: ha manni – rabbi natan hi, deamar: baal habbor hezzeka ka aved, vechol hecha dela efshar leishtallome mehay – mishtallem mehay;
Detanya: shor sheddachaf et chavero levor – baal hashshor chayyayv, baal habbor patur. rabbi natan omer: baal hashshor meshallem mechetza, uvaal habbor meshallem mechetza.
Vehatanya, rabbi natan omer: baal habbor meshallem shelosha chalakim, uvaal hashshor revia! la kashya; ha betam, ha bemuad.
Uvetam may kasavar? i kasavar: hay kulleh hezzeka avad vehay kulleh hezzeka avad – hay meshallem palga, vehay meshallem palga!
Vei kasavar: hay palga hezzeka avad, vehay palga hezzeka avad – baal habbor meshallem palga uvaal hashshor revia, veiddach riva mafsid?

Amar rava: rabbi natan dayyayna hu, venachet leumeka dedina; leolam kasavar: hay kulleh hezzeka avad, vehay kulleh hezzeka avad; udeka kashya lach leshallem hay palga vehay palga, mishshum deamar leh baal hashshor levaal habbor: shuttafutay may ahanya li?

Ibbaet ema, leolam kasavar: hay palga hezzeka avad, vehay palga hezzeka avad; udeka kashya lach: baal habbor meshallem palga uvaal hashshor meshallem revia, veiddach riva nafsed – mishshum daamar leh baal hashshor levaal habbor: ana toray beverach ashkechiteh – at ketalteh; may deit li leishtallome mehayech – mishtallamna, may delet li leishtallome mehayech – mishtallamna mimmach.
Amar rava: hinniach even al pi habbor, uva shor venitkal bah, venafal babbor – banu lemachloket rabbi natan verabbanan. peshita!

Mahu detema, hatam hu deamar baal habbor levaal hashshor: "i lav bera didi – tora didach hava katel leh"; aval hacha, matze amar leh baal even levaal habbor: "i lav bera didach, avna didi may hava avda? i hava mittekel bah – hava nafel vekae!" ka mashma lan, daamar leh: "i lav even – la hava nafel levera".
Ittemar:
b: Shor veshor pesule hammukedashin shennagchu – may nihu? shor bechor, dela parek leh; abbaye amar: meshallem chatzi nezek, ravina amar: meshallem revia nezek.
Ha veha betam; ha kerabbanan, veha kerabbi natan.
Ibbaet ema: ha veha kerabbanan; ha betam, ha bemuad.
Ikka deamri – abbaye amar: chatzi nezek, ravina amar: kulleh nezek. ha veha bemuad; ha kerabbanan, veha kerabbi natan.
Ibbaet ema: ha veha kerabbi natan; ha bemuad, veha betam.
Amar rava: shor veadam sheddachafu levor, leinyan nezakin – kullan chayyayvin. leinyan arbaa devarim udeme veladot – adam chayyayv, veshor uvor patur.
Leinyan kofer usheloshim shel eved – shor chayyayv, adam uvor peturim. leinyan kelim veshor pesule hammukedashin – adam veshor chayyayvin, uvor patur.
May tama? amar kera: "vehammet yihye lo" – bemi shehammet shello, yatza ze sheen hammet shello.

Lememra difshita leh lerava? veha mibbaya bae leh lerava – devae rava: shor pesule hammukedashin shennafal labbor, mahu? hay "vehammet yihye lo" – bemi shehammet shello, yatza ze sheen hammet shello; o dilma, "vehammet yihye lo" – livalim mittappelin bannevela hu daata?
Batar devaya, hadar pashta.

Ella bealim mittappelin binvela – mena leh? nafka leh min "vehammet yihye lo" deshor. may chazet divhammet yihye lo" deshor – mappekat leh livalim mittappelin binvela, "vehammet yihye lo" devor – mappekat leh lemi shehammet shello? efoch ana!
Mistabbera petur gabbe vor – hoil ufatar bo et hakkelim. adderabba, petur gabbe shor – shekken patar bo chatzi nezek! kulleh nezek mihat la ashkechan.
Nafal letocho shor vechelav, venishtabberu kulei. matnitin dela kerabbi yehuda – detanya: rabbi yehuda mechayyev al nizke chelim bevor.
May tama derabbanan? deamar kera: "venafal shamma shor o chamor"; "shor" – velo adam, "chamor" – velo kelim. verabbi yehuda – "o", lerabbot et hakkelim. verabbanan –

a: "O", mibbee leh lechallek. verabbi yehuda – lechallek mivvenafal" nafka. verabbanan – "venafal", tuva mashma.
Ema "venafal" – kalal, "shor vachamor" – parat; kelal uferat – en bakkelal ella ma shebbapperat; shor vachamor – in, midde acharina – la!
Amri: "baal habbor yeshallem" – chazar vechalal. kelal uferat uchelal – i atta dan ella cheen happerat; ma happerat meforash – baale chayyim, af kol baale chayyim.
I, ma happerat meforash, davar shennivlato metammea bemagga uvemassa – af kol davar shennivlato metammea bemagga uvemassa, aval ofot lo!

Im ken, nichtov rachamana chad perata! he nichtov? i ketav "shor", hava amena: karev legabbe mizbeach – in, sheeno karev legabbe mizbeach – la. vei ketav rachamana "chamor", hava amena: kadosh bivchora – in, sheen kadosh bivchora – la!
Ella amar kera: "vehammet yihye lo" – kol devar mita.
Ben lerabbanan deka memaati lehu lechelim, uven lerabbi yehuda deka merabbe lehu lechelim – kelim bene mita ninhu?! amri: sheviratan zo hi mitatan.
Ulerav deamar: bor shechiyyeyva alav tora – lehevlo velo lachavato; ben lerabbanan ben lerabbi yehuda – kelim bene havela ninhu?! amri: bechadte, demippaki mehavela.
Hay "vehammet yihye lo" mibbee leh lechidrava, deamar rava: shor pesule hammukedashin shennafal levor – patur, shenneemar: "vehammet yihye lo" – bemi shehammet shello, yatza ze sheen hammet shello.
Ella amar kera: "kesef yashiv livalav" – lerabbot kol deit leh bealim. i hachi, afillu kelim veadam name!
Amar kera: "shor" – velo adam, "chamor" – velo kelim. ulerabbi yehuda deka merabbe lehu lechelim, bishlama "shor" – memaet beh adam, ella "chamor" may memaet beh?
Ella amar rava: "chamor" devor lerabbi yehuda, vese" daaveda ledivre hakkol – kashya.
Nafal letocho shor cheresh shote vekatan – chayyayv. may "shor cheresh shote vekatan"? ilema shor shel cheresh, shor shel shote, shor shel katan – ha shor shel pikkeach patur?!
Amar rabbi yochanan: shor shehu cheresh, shor shehu shote, shor shehu katan.
b: Ha shor shehu pikkeach – patur?
Amar rabbi yirmeya: la mibbaya kaamar; la mibbaya shor shehu pikkeach – dechayyayv; aval shor cheresh shote vekatan, ema chershuto garma lo, katnuto garma lo, velippetar; ka mashma lan.

Amar leh rav acha leravina, vehatanya: nafal letocho bar daat – patur. may, lav shor bar daat? amar leh: la, adam. ella meatta, adam ben daat hu defatur, ha lav ben daat hu – dechayyayv? "shor" – velo adam ketiv!
Ella may "ben daat" – min ben daat. amar leh, vehatanya: nafal letocho shor ben daat – patur!

Ella amar rava: shor vehu cheresh, shor vehu shote, shor vehu katan – davka; aval shor vehu pikkeach – patur. may tama? devae leh ayyone umezal. tanya name hachi: nafal letocho shor cheresh, shote, vekatan, vesome, umehallech ballayla – chayyayv. pikkeach umehallech bayom – patur.
Mishna echad shor veechad kol behema – linfilat habbor, ulehafrashat har sinay, uletashlume chefel, velahashavat aveda, lifrika, lachasima, lakkilayim, velashshabbat.
Vechen chayya vaof kayyotze bahen. im ken, lamma neemar "shor o chamor"? ella sheddibber hakkatuv bahove.

Gemara linfilat habbor – "kesef yashiv livalav" ketiv – kol deit leh bealim, kedaamaran. lehaferashat har sinay – "im behema im ish lo yichye", vechayya bichlal behema havya; "im" – lerabbot et haofot.
Letashlume chefel – kidamrinan: "al kol devar pesha" – kalal kol devar peshia. lahashavat aveda – "lechol avedat achicha". lifrika – yalef "chamor"–"chamor" mishshabbat.
Lachasima – yalef "shor"–"shor" mishshabbat.
Lechilayim – i kilayim dacharisha, yalef "shor"–"shor" mishshabbat;
I kilayim deharbaa, yalef "behemtecha"–"behemtecha" mishshabbat.

Vegabbe shabbat menalan? detanya: rabbi yose omer mishshum rabbi yishmael, bedibberot harishonot neemar: "avdecha vaamatcha uvehemtecha", uvedibberot haacharonot neemar: "veshorcha vachamorcha vechol behemtecha". vahalo shor vachamor bichlal kol behema hayu, velamma yatzu? lomar lach: ma shor vachamor haamur kan – chayya vaof kayyotze bahen, af kol chayya vaof kayyotze bahen.
Ema: "behema" dedibberot harishonot – kalal, "shorcha vachamorcha" dedibberot haacharonot – parat; kelal uferat – en bakkelal ella ma shebbapperat; shor vachamor – in, midde acharina – la!
Amri: "vechol behemtecha" dedibberot haacharonot – chazar vechalal. kelal uferat uchelal – i atta dan ella keen happerat; ma happerat meforash – baale chayyim, af kol baale chayyim.
Veema: ma happerat meforash – davar shennivlato metammea[5] bemagga uvemassa, af kol davar shennevalato metammea[5] bemagga uvemassa; aval ofot – lo!

Amri: im ken, nichtov rachamana chad perata! he nichtov rachamana? i ketav rachamana "shor", hava amena: karev legabbe mizbeach – in, sheeno karev legabbe mizbeach – la; ketav rachamana "chamor". vei ketav rachamana "chamor", hava amena: kadosh bivchora – in, sheen kadosh bivchora – la; ketav rachamana "shor".
Ella "vechol behemtecha" – ribbuya hu.
Vechol hecha dichtav rachamana "kol" – ribbuya hu?! veha gabbe maaser dichtiv "kol", veka darshinan leh bichlal uferat!
Detanya: "venatatta hakkesef bechol asher teavve nafshecha" – kalal, "babbakar uvatztzon uvayyayin uvashshechar" – parat, "uvechol asher tisholcha nafshecha" – chazar vechalal;
Kelal uferat uchelal – i atta dan ella keen happerat, ma happerat meforash – peri mipperi vegiddule karka, af kol peri mipperi vegiddule karka!

Amri: "bechol" – kelala, "kol" – ribbuya. ibbaet ema: "kol" name kelala hu, mihu hay "kol" dehacha – ribbuya hu; middahava leh lemichtav: "uvehemtecha" kedichtiv bedibberot harishonot, uchetav: "vechol behemtecha" – shema minna ribbuya.
Hasheta deamrat: "kol" – ribbuya hu; "behemtecha" dedibberot harishonot, veshor vachamor" dedibberot haacharonot – lema li?
Amri: "shor" – leagmore "shor"–"shor" lachasima,
"Chamor" – leagmore "chamor"–"chamor" lifrika,
"Behemtecha" – leagmore "behemtecha"–"behemtecha" lechilayim.
I hachi, afillu adam littesar! allema tenan: adam muttar im kullan lachrosh velimshoch?
Amar rav pappa: pappunae yadi tama deha milleta – umannu? rav acha bar yaakov; amar kera: "lemaan yanuach avdecha vaamatcha kamocha" – lehannacha hikkashtiv, velo ledavar acher.
Shaal rabbi chanina ben agel et rabbi chiyyay bar abba: mippene ma bedibberot harishonot lo neemar bahem "tov", uvedibberot haacharonot

a: Neemar bahem "tov"? amar lo: ad sheatta shoaleni lamma neemar bahem "tov", shealeni im neemar bahen "tov" im lav – sheeni yodea im neemar bahen "tov" im lav; kelach etzel rabbi tanchum bar chanilay, shehaya ragil etzel rabbi yehoshua ben levi – shehaya baki beaggada.

Azal legabbeh. amar leh: mimmennu lo shamati, ella kach amar li shemuel bar nachum achi immo shel rav acha berabbi chanina, veamri la avi immo shel rav achay berabbi chanina: hoil vesofan lehishtabber.
Vechi sofan lehishtabber may have? amar rav ashe: chas veshalom, paska tova miyyisrael.
Amar rabbi yehoshua: haroe tet bachalomo – siman yafe lo. may tama? illema mishshum dichtiv "tov", ema: "vetetetiha bematate hashemed"! chad tet kaamrinan.
Ema: "tumatah beshuleha"! tet bet kaamrinan. ema: "tavu baaretz sheareha"!
Ella hoil ufatach bo hakkatuv letova techilla – shemmibbereshit" ad "vayyar elohim et haor", la ketiv tet.
Veamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: haroe hesped bachalomo – chasu alav min hashshamayim, ufedauhu. hane mille bichtava.
Vechen chayya vaof kayyotze bahen vechulei. amar resh lakish, kan shana rabbi: tarnegol, tauos ufasyoni – kilayim ze baze.
Peshita! amar rav chaviva: mishshum deravu bahade hadade – mahu detema: min chad hu; ka mashma lan.

Amar shemuel: auoz veauoz habbar – kilayim ze baze. matkef la rava bar rav chanan: may tama? illema mishshum dehay arich koeh vehay zutar koeh; ella meatta, gamla parsa vegamla tayyaya, dehay allim koeh vehay kattin koeh, hachi name dehavu kilayim ze baze?!
Ella amar abbaye: ze betzav mibbachutz, veze betzav mibbifnim. rav pappa amar: ha teuna chada beata beshichla, veha teuna kamma beata beshichla.
Amar rabbi yirmeya amar resh lakish: hammarbia shene minim shebbayyam – loke. may tama? amar rav adda bar ahava mishshemeh deulla: atya "leminehu"–"leminehu" miyyabbasha.
Bae rachava: hammanhig beizza veshibbuta, mahu? mi amrinan: kevan deizza la nachet bayyam, veshibbuta la salek layyabbasha – lo kelum aved; o dilma, hasheta mihat ka manheg?
Matkef la ravina: ella meatta, chibber chitta useora beyado, vezara chitta baaretz useora bechutza laaretz, hachi name demichayyayv?
Amri: hachi hasheta?! hatam – eretz mekom chiyyuva, chutza laaretz la mekom chiyyuva; hacha – idde veidde chiyyuva hu.
Hadaran alach shor shennagach et happara
b: Mishna hakkones tzon laddir, venaal befaneha karauy, veyatza vehizzika – patur. lo naal befaneha karauy, veyatza vehizzika – chayyayv.
Nifretza ballayla o shepperatzuha listim, veyatza vehizzika – patur. hotziuha listim – listim chayyayvin.
Hinnicha bachamma, o shemmesarah lecheresh shote vekatan, veyatza vehizzika – chayyayv.
Mesarah leroe – nichnas haroe tachtav.

Nafla leginna venehenet – meshallemet ma shennehenet. yarda kedarkah vehizzika – meshallemet ma shehizzika. ketzad meshallemet ma shehizzika? shamin bet sea beotah sade – kamma hayta yafa, vechamma hi yafa.
Rabbi shimon omer: achla perot gemurim – meshallemet perot gemurim. im sea – sea, im satayim – satayim.
Gemara tanu rabbanan: ezehu "karauy", veezehu "shello karauy"? delet sheyyechola laamod beruach metzuya – zehu karauy. sheenah yechola laamod beruach metzuya – zehu shello karauy.

Amar rabbi mani bar pattish: man tanna muad desaggi leh bishmira pechuta – rabbi yehuda hi, ditnan: kesharo bealav bemosera, venaal lefanav karauy, veyatza vehizzik – echad tam veechad muad, chayyayv; divre rabbi meir.
Rabbi yehuda omer: tam – chayyayv, muad – patur; shenneemar: "velo yishmerennu bealav" – veshamur hu ze. rabbi eliezer omer: en lo shemira ella sakkin.

Afillu tema rabbi meir, shane shen varegel – dehattora miata bishmiratan. deamar rabbi elazar, veamri la bematnita tana: arbaa devarim hattora miata bishmiratan, veellu hen: bor, vaesh, shen, varegel.
Bor – dichtiv: "ki yiftach ish bor o ki yichre ish bor, velo yechassennu", ha kissahu – patur.
Esh – dichtiv: "shallem yeshallem hammavir et habbeera" – ad deaved keen mavir.
Shen – dichtiv: "uvier bisde acher" – ad deaved keen "uvier".
Regel – dichtiv: "veshillach" – ad deaved keen veshillach.
Vetanya: "veshillach" – ze haregel, vechen hu omer: "meshalleche regel hashshor vehachamor". "uvier" – ze hashshen, vechen hu omer: "kaasher yevaer haggalal ad tummo".
Tama deaved keen "veshillach" "uvier", ha la aved – la.
Amar rabba: matnitin name dayka, dekatane "tzon" – mikkede beshor ka askinan veate, nitne "shor"! may shena dekatane "tzon"? lav mishshum dehattora miata bishmiratan?
Lav; mishshum dechan keren la ketiva ba, shen varegel hu dichtiv beh; veka mashma lan deshen varegel – demuadin hu. shema minna.

Tanya, amar rabbi yehoshua: arbaa devarim haose otan patur middine adam, vechayyayv bedine shamayim. veellu hen: happoretz gader bifne behemat chavero, vehakkofef kamato shel chavero bifne haddeleka, vehassocher ede sheker lehaid, vehayyodea edut lachavero veeno meid lo.
Amar mar: happoretz gader bifne behemat chavero. hechi dame? illema bechotel bari – bedine adam name nichayyayv! ella

a: Bechotel raua.
Amar mar: hakkofef kamato shel chavero bifne haddeleka. hechi dame? illema dematya leh beruach metzuya, bedine adam name nichayyayv! ella dematya beruach sheenah metzuya.
Verav ashe amar: tamun ittemar, mishshum deshavveya tamun baesh.
Amar mar: hassocher ede sheker. hechi dame? illema lenafsheh – mamona bae shallome, uvedine adam name nichayyayv! ella lechavreh.
Vehayyodea edut lachavero veeno meid lo. bemay askinan? ilema beve tere – peshita! deorayyta hu – "im lo yaggid, venasa avono"!
Ella bechad.
Vetu lekka? vehaikka (siman: haose, besam, usheliach, chavero, nishbar.) haose melacha beme chattat uvefarat chattat – patur middine adam, vechayyayv bedine shamayim!
Vehaikka hannoten sam hammavet bifne behemat chavero – patur middine adam, vechayyayv bedine shamayim!
Vehaikka hashsholeach et habbeera beyad cheresh shote vekatan – patur middine adam, vechayyayv bedine shamayim!
Vehaikka hammavit et chavero – patur middine adam, vechayyayv bedine shamayim!
Vehaikka nishbera kaddo birshut harabbim velo sillekah, nafla gemallo velo heemidah – rabbi meir mechayyev behezzekan, vachachamim omrim: patur bedine adam, vechayyayv bedine shamayim!
In, miha ikka tuva; vehane itztericha leh – mahu detema bedine shamayim name la lichayyayv, ka mashma lan.
Happoretz gader bifne behemat chavero – mahu detema: kevan dilmistereh kae, ma aved? bedine shamayim name la lichayyayv; ka mashma lan.
Hakkofef kamato shel chavero name – mahu detema, lema: mi hava yadana deatya ruach sheenah metzuya? uvedine shamayim name la lichayyayv; ka mashma lan.
Ulerav ashe – deamar name tamun ittemar, mahu detema: "ana kassoye kassiteh nihalach", uvedine shamayim name la lichayyayv; ka mashma lan.
Vehassocher ede sheker name – mahu detema, lema: divre harav vedivre hattalmid, divre mi shomin? uvedine shamayim name la lichayyayv; ka mashma lan.
Vehayyodea edut lachavero veeno meid lo, name – mahu detema: "mi yemar dechi hava atena mashedyna leh hava mode, dilma hava mishteva leshikra", uvedine shamayim name la lichayyayv; ka mashma lan.
Nifretza ballayla o shepperatzuha listim kulei. amar rabba: vehu shechatra.
Aval lo chatra may, chayyayv?! hechi dame? illema bechotel bari – ki lo chatra ammay chayyayv? may hava leh lemebad? ella bechotel raua – ki chatra ammay patur? techillato bifshia vesofo beones hu!
Hanicha leman deamar: techillato bifshia vesofo beones patur; ella leman deamar: techillato bifshia vesofo beones chayyayv – may ikka lememar?

Ella matnitin bechotel bari, vaafillu lo chatra. vechi ittemar derabba – assefa ittemar: hannicha bachamma, o shemmesarah lecheresh shote vekatan, veyatzta vehizzika – chayyayv. amar rabba: vaafillu chatra.
La mibbaya hecha dela chatra – dechulla bifshia hu, ella afillu chatra name. mahu detema: havya la techillato bifshia vesofo beones; ka mashma lan dechulla peshia hi,
May tama? daamar leh: midda yadat dechevan dishvakta bechamma – kol tatzdeka deit la lemibad avda venafka.
Hotziuha listim – listim chayyayvin.
b: Peshita! kevan deappekuha – kayyma la birshutayyhu lechol mille!
La tzericha, dekamu la beappa. ki ha deamar rabba amar rav matna amar rav: hammaamid behemat chavero al kamat chavero – chayyayv. maamid – peshita! la tzericha, dekam la beappa.
Amar leh abbaye lerav yosef: hikkishah amart lan, velistim name dehikkishuha.

Mesarah leroe – nichnas haroe kulei. amri: tachtav deman? ilema tachtav devaal behema – tenena chada zimna: mesaro leshomer chinnam, uleshoel, lenose sachar, ulesocher – kullan nichnesu tachat habbealim! ella tachtav deshomer.
Veshomer kamma ippetar leh ligmare? lema tehve teyuveta derava – deamar rava: shomer shemmasar leshomer – chayyayv?
Amar lach rava: may "mesaro leroe" – levarzileh, deorcheh deroe lemimsar levarzileh.
Ikka deamri: middekatane "mesarah leroe" vela katane "mesarah leacher", shema minna may "mesarah leroe" – mesar roe levarzileh, deorcheh deroe lemimsar levarzile; aval leacher – la.
Lema mesayyay leh lerava – deamar rava: shomer shemmasar leshomer chayyayv? amri: la; dilma orcha demilleta katane, vehu haddin leacher.
Ittemar: shomer aveda – rabba amar: keshomer chinnam dame, rav yosef amar: keshomer sachar dame.
Rabba amar keshomer chinnam dame – may hanaa ka mate leh? rav yosef amar keshomer sachar dame – behahi hanaa dela baaya lemittavoy leh rifta leanya, have keshomer sachar.
Ikka dimfarshi hachi: rav yosef amar keshomer sachar dame – kevan derachamana shabedeh beal kurecheh, hilkach keshomer sachar dame.
(Siman: hechzirah, leolam, hashev, chiyyay, amarta, nishbar, sachar.)
Etiveh rav yosef lerabba:

a: Hechzirah limkom sheyyirenna – eno chayyayv littappel bah. nigneva o avda – chayyayv beachrayutah.
May "nigneva o avda"? lav nigneva mibbeto veavda mibbeto?
La, mimmekom shehechzirah.
Veha katane: eno chayyayv littappel bah!
Amar leh: hacha bemay askinan – kegon shehechzirah batztzohorayim.

Vetarte katane, vehachi katane: hechzirah shacharit limkom sheyyirenna, ushechiach deayel venafek vechaze la – eno chayyayv littappel bah. hechzirah batztzohorayim limkom sheyyirenna, dela shechiach deayel venafek, dela chaze la; venigneva o avda – chayyayv beachrayutah.
Etiveh: leolam hu chayyayv, ad sheyyachzirenna lirshuto. may "leolam"? lav afillu mibbeto? shema minna keshomer sachar dame!
Amar leh: modena lach bevaale chayyim, dechevan denakti lehu nigre barayayta – bae netiruta yattirta.
Etiveh rabba lerav yosef: "hashev" – en li ella beveto, leginnato ulechurebato minnayin? talmud lomar: "teshivem" mikkol makom.

May "leginnato ulechurebato"? ilema leginnato hammishtammeret ulechurebato hammishtammeret, hayeynu beto! ella peshita, leginnato sheenah mishtammeret ulechurebato sheenah mishtammeret. shema minna keshomer chinnam dame!
Amar leh: leolam leginnato hammishtammeret ulechurebato hammishtammeret, udeka kashya lach: hayeynu beto, ha ka mashma lan – dela baenan daat bealim, kidrabbi elazar.
Deamar rabbi elazar: hakkol tzerichin daat bealim, chutz mehashavat aveda – shehare ribbeta bo tora hashavot harebe.

Amar leh abbaye lerav yosef: veat la tisbera deshomer aveda keshomer chinnam dame? veha amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: hattoen taanat gannav baaveda – meshallem tashlume chefel. vei salka datach shomer sachar have, ammay meshallem tashlume chefel? karna bae shallome!
Amar leh: hacha bemay askinan – kegon shettoen taanat listim mezuyyayn.
Amar leh: listim mezuyyayn – gazlan hu!
Amar leh, sheani omer: listim mezuyyayn, kevan demittammar meinashe – gannav hu.
Etiveh:
b: Lo; im amarta beshomer chinnam – shekken meshallem tashlume chefel, tomar beshomer sachar – sheeno meshallem tashlume chefel?
Vei salka datach listim mezuyyayn gannav hu, nimtza beshomer sachar meshallem tashlume chefel – betoen taanat listim mezuyyayn!

Amar leh, hachi kaamar: lo; im amarta beshomer chinnam – shekken meshallem tashlume chefel bechol taanotav, tomar beshomer sachar – sheeno meshallem tashlume chefel ella betoen taanat listim mezuyyayn.

Etiveh: "venishbar o met" – en li ella shevura umeta, geneva vaaveda minnayin? amarta kal vachomer – uma shomer sachar, sheppatar bo shevura umeta, chayyayv bigneva vaaveda; shoel, shechayyayv bishvura umeta – eno din shechayyayv bigneva vaaveda? vezehu kal vechomer sheen alav teshuva.
Vei salka datach listim mezuyyayn gannav hu, ammay en alav teshuva? ikka lemifrach: ma leshomer sachar – shekken meshallem tashlume chefel betoen taanat listim mezuyyayn!
Amar leh, kasavar hay tanna: karna belo shevua adifa mikkefela bishvua.
Lema mesayyay leh: hassocher para mechavero, venigneva, veamar halla: "hareni meshallem veeni nishba", veachar kach nimtza haggannav – meshallem tashlume chefel lassocher.
Savruha – kerabbi yehuda, deamar: socher kenose sachar dame; umiddekatane: veamar "hareni meshallem veeni nishba" – mikkelal dei bae, patar (leh) nafsheh bishvua.
Hechi dame – kegon deka taen taanat listim mezuyyayn; vekatane: veachar kach nimtza haggannav – meshallem tashlume chefel lassocher; shema minna: listim mezuyyayn gannav hu!
Amri, mi savrat kerabbi yehuda – deamar: socher kenose sachar dame? dilma kerabbi meir sevira leh, deamar: socher keshomer chinnam dame.
Ibbaet ema, kidmachlef rabba bar avu vetane: socher ketzad meshallem? rabbi meir omer: keshomer sachar, rabbi yehuda omer: keshomer chinnam.
Rabbi zera amar: hacha bemay askinan – betoen taanat listim mezuyyayn, venimtza listim sheeno mezuyyayn.
Nafla leginna venehenet – meshallemet ma shennehenet. amar rav: benechbeta;
Aval achla – afillu ma shennehenet enah meshallemet. lema rav letameh, daamar rav: haya la shello tochal?

Amri: hachi hasheta?! emor deamar rav hatam "haya la shello tochal" – hecha deittazka hi, dematze amar leh mareh defere: "la meshallamna, haya la shello tochal"; leazzoke hi acharine, diftira leshallome, mi amar?!
Ella

a: "La mibbaya" kaamar: la mibbaya achla – dimshallemet ma shennehenet; aval nechbeta – ema mavriach ari minnichse chavero hu, uma shennehenet name la meshallem; ka mashma lan.
Veema hachi name!
Mavriach ari minnichse chavero – middato hu, hay – lav middato. i name, mavriach ari minnichse chavero – let leh peseda, hay – it leh peseda.
Hechi nafal? rav kahana amar: shehuchelka bememe ragleha, rava amar: sheddechafatta chavertah.

Man deamar sheddechafatta chavertah – kol shekken shehuchelka bememe ragleha. uman deamar shehuchelka bememe ragleha – aval dechafatta chavertah, pasha, umeshallemet ma shehizzika; daamar leh: ibbei lach abbore chada chada.

Amar rav kahana: lo shanu ella beotah aruga, aval mearuga laaruga – meshallemet ma shehizzika. verabbi yochanan amar: afillu mearuga laaruga, vaafillu kol hayyom kullo – ad shettetze vetachazor ledaat.

Amar rav pappa: la tema ad shettetze ledaat vetachazor ledaat, ella kevan sheyyatzta ledaat – af al pi shechazra shello ledaat. may tama? daamar leh: kevan deyalfa, kol emat demishtamta – lehatam rahata.
Yarda kedarkah vehizzika – meshallemet ma shehizzika. bae rabbi yirmeya: yarda kedarkah vehizzika beme leda, mahu?
Allibba deman deamar techillato bifshia vesofo beones chayyayv, la tibbee lach; ki tibbee lach – allibba deman deamar techillato bifshia vesofo beones patur; may?
Mi amrinan: kevan ditchillato bifshia vesofo beones – patur; o dilma, hacha kulla bifshia hu – dechevan deka chaze dikriva la lemelad, ibbei leh lenatora
b: Uleistammore begavva? teku.
Ketzad meshallemet ma shehizzika vechulei. mena hane mille?
Amar rav matna, deamar kera: "uvier bisde acher" – melammed sheshshamin al gav sade acher.
