Hay "uvier bisde acher" mibbee leh leappoke reshut harabbim!
Im ken, lichtov rachamana "uvier bisde chavero", i name "sede acher"! may "bisde acher"? sheshshamin al gav sade acher.
Veema kulleh lehachi hu daata; leappoke reshut harabbim menalan?
Im ken, lichteveh rachamana gabbe tashlumin – "metav sadehu umetav karmo yeshallem bisde acher"! lema li dechatveh rachamana gabbe "uvier"? shema minna tarte.
Hechi shayyminan? amar rabbi yose bar chanina: sea beshishshim sein. rabbi yannay amar: tarkav beshishshim tarkabbim. chizkiyya amar: kelach beshishshim kelachim.
Metivi: achla kav o kabbayim – en omrim teshallem demehen, ella roin otah keillu hi aruga ketanna, umeshaarim otah. may, lav bifne atzmah?
La, beshishshim.
Tanu rabbanan: en shamin kav – mippene shemmashbicho, velo bet kor – mippene sheppogmo.
May kaamar? amar rav pappa, hachi kaamar: en shamin kav beshishshim kabbim – mippene shemmashbiach mazzik, velo kor beshishshim korin – mippene sheppogem mazzik.
Matkef la rav huna bar manoach: hay "velo bet kor"?! "velo kor" mibbee leh!

Ella amar rav huna bar manoach mishshemeh derav acha bereh derav ika, hachi katane: en shamin kav bifne atzmo – mippene shemmashbiach nizzak, velo kav bevet kor – mippene sheppogem nizzak; ella beshishshim.

Hahu gavra dekatz kashba mechavreh. ata lekammeh deresh galuta, amar leh: ledidi chaze li, utelata talata bekinna havo kayymi, vahavo shavu mea zuze. zil hav leh telatin utelata vetilta. amar: gabbe resh galuta dedaen dina defarsaa, lema li? ata lekammeh derav nachman, amar leh: beshishshim.
Amar leh rava: im amru benizke mamono, yomru benizke gufo?!

Amar leh abbaye lerava: benizke gufo may dataych – detanya: hammavkir karmo shel chavero semadar – roin oto kamma haya yafe kodem lachen, vechamma hu yafe leachar mikkan; veillu beshishshim la katane?

Attu gabbe vehemto name mi la tanya ki hay gavvna?! detanya: katma netia – rabbi yose omer, gozre gezerot shebbirushalayim omrim: netia bat shenatah – shete kesef, bat shete shanim – arbaa kesef. achla chaziz – rabbi yose haggelili omer: niddon bamshuyyayr shebbo, vachachamim omrim: roin otah kamma hayta yafa, vechamma hi yafa.

a: Achla semadar – rabbi yehoshua omer: roin otan keillu hen anavim omdot libbatzer, vachachamim omrim: roin kamma hayta yafa vechamma hi yafa. rabbi shimon ben yehuda omer mishshum rabbi shimon: bamme devarim amurim – bizman sheachla luleve gefanim veyichure teenim, aval achla paggim o voser – roin otan keillu anavim omdot libbatzer.
Katane mihat, vachachamim omrim: roin otan kamma hayta yafa, vechamma hi yafa – vela katane beshishshim!
Ella may it lach lememar – beshishshim; hacha name beshishshim.
Amar abbaye: rabbi yose haggelili verabbi yishmael amru davar echad.
Rabbi yose haggelili – ha daamaran.

Rabbi yishmael – detanya: "metav sadehu umetav karmo yeshallem" – metav sadehu shel nizzak, umetav karmo shel nizzak; divre rabbi yishmael. rabbi akiva omer: lo ba hakkatuv ella ligbot lannizzakin min haiddit, vekal vachomer lahekdesh.

Vela tema kerav idi bar avin – deamar rav idi bar avin: kegon sheachla aruga ben haarugot, vela yadinan i kechusha havay i shemena havay, deamar: kum shallem shemena bemetav deikka hasheta; dehachi la amrinan.
May tama? hammotzi mechavero alav haraya. ella bemetav dilkammeh, umay nihu – ki hayech desalek.

Amar mar, rabbi shimon ben yehuda omer mishshum rabbi shimon: bamme devarim amurim – sheachla luleve gefanim veyichure teenim. ha semadar – roin otan keillu anavim omdot libbatzer. ema sefa: achla paggim o voser hu deroin otan keillu anavim omdot libbatzer, ha semadar – roin otan kamma hi yafa vechamma hayta yafa!
Amar ravina, keroch uteni: bamme devarim amurim – bizman sheachla luleve gefanim veyichure teenim, aval achla semadar paggin o voser – roin otan keillu anavim omdot libbatzer.
I hachi, rabbi shimon ben yehuda hayeynu rabbi yehoshua!
Ikka benayyhu kechash gufena; vela mesayyeymi.

Abbaye amar: mesayyeymi umesayyeymi! man tanna dechayesh lichchash gufena – rabbi shimon ben yehuda hi, detanya, rabbi shimon ben yehuda omer mishshum rabbi shimon ben menasya: ones eno meshallem et hatztzaar, mippene shessofah lehitztaer tachat balah. amru lo: eno dome nivelet beratzon lenivelet beones.
Amar abbaye: hane tannae, verabbi shimon ben yehuda, amru davar echad. rabbi shimon ben yehuda – ha daamaran. hane tannae may hi –
Detanya, rabbi yose omer: neche chayya. ben azzay omer: neche mezonot.
Man deamar neche chayya, kol shekken neche mezonot. uman deamar neche mezonot, aval neche chayya – la, deamar leh: itteta didi pekicha hi, vela mibbaya chayya.
Rav pappa verav huna bereh derav yehoshua avud ovada kevoteh derav nachman beshishshim.
Lishshana acharina: rav pappa verav huna bereh derav yehoshua shamu dikla aggav kattina deara.
Vehilcheta kevoteh derav pappa verav huna bereh derav yehoshua bedikla (da)arammaa, vehilcheta kevoteh deresh galuta bedikla farsaa.
Eliezer zeera
b: Hava sayem mesane ukkame, vekae beshuka dinhardea. ashkechu deve resh galuta vaamaru leh: may shena hane mesane? amar lehu: deka miavilna ayyerushalayim. amaru leh: at chashivat leitavole ayyerushalayim? sevur yuhara hava, atyu vechavshu.
Amar lehu: gavra rabba ana. amaru leh: mena yadinan? amar lehu: o attun beo minnay milleta, o ana ive minnayychu milleta. amaru leh: bei at.
Amar lehu: hay man dekatz kufera, may meshallem? amaru leh: meshallem deme chufera. veha havo tamre! amaru leh: meshallem deme tamre. amar lehu: veha lav tamre shekal minneh!

Amaru leh: ema lan at. amar lehu: beshishshim. amaru leh: man amar kevotaych? amar lehu: ha shemuel chay uvet dino kayyaym. shaddaru kammeh dishmuel, amar lehu: shappir kaamar lechu beshishshim, veshavkuhv.

Rabbi shimon omer: achla perot gemurim kulei. may tama? ha deamar rachamana "uvier bisde acher" – melammed sheshshamin al gav hassade, hane mille midde ditzrich lesade; hane, kevan dela tzerichi lesade – beenayyhu bae shallome.
Amar rav huna bar chiyyay amar rabbi yirmeya bar abba: dan rav kerabbi meir, ufesak hilcheta kerabbi shimon.

Dan rav kerabbi meir – detanya: katav larishon velo chatma lo, lashsheni vechatma lo – ibbeda ketubbatah, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer, yechola hi shettomar: nachat ruach asiti levali, attem ma lachem alay.
Ufesak hilcheta kerabbi shimon – ki ha ditnan, rabbi shimon omer: achla perot gemurin – meshallemet perot gemurin; im sea – sea, im satayim – satayim.
Mishna hammagdish betoch sede chavero shello birshut, vaachalatan behemto shel baal hassade – patur. veim huzzeka bahen – baal haggadish chayyayv. veim higdish birshut – baal hassade chayyayv.

Gemara lema tenan dela kerabbi? dei kerabbi, haamar: ad sheyyekabbel alav baal habbayit lishmor! amar rav pappa: hacha – benatar be dare askinan, dechevan daamar leh: "ayyel ugedosh" – "ayyel veentar lach" hu.
Mishna hashsholeach et habbeera beyad cheresh shote vekatan – patur bedine adam, vechayyayv bedine shamayim. shillach beyad pikkeach – happikkeach chayyayv.
Echad hevi et haur veechad hevi et haetzim – hammevi et haetzim chayyayv. echad hevi et haetzim veechad hevi et haur – hammevi et haur chayyayv.
Ba acher velibba – hamelabbe chayyayv. libbeta haruach – kullan peturin.
Gemara amar resh lakish mishshemeh dechizkiyya: lo shanu ella shemmasar lo gachelet velibbah, aval masar lo shalhevet – chayyayv, may tama? maasav ka garmu lo.
Verabbi yochanan amar: afillu masar lo shalhevet – patur, may tama? tzevata decheresh garma lo. vela michayyayv ad sheyyimsor lo gevoza,

a: Silta, sheraga, dehahu vadday maase dideh garmu.
Shillach beyad pikkeach – happikkeach chayyayv vechulei. amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: man detane "libba" la mishtabbash, uman detane "nibba" la mishtabbash.
Man detane "libba" la mishtabbash – dichtiv: "belabbat esh". uman detane "nibba" la mishtabbash – dichtiv: "bore niv sefatayim".
Libbeta haruach – kullan peturin. tanu rabbanan: libba velibbeta haruach, im yesh belibbuyo kede lelabbotah – chayyayv, veim lav – patur.
Ammay? leheve kezore veruach mesayyayto!

Amar abbaye: hacha bemay askinan – kegon shellibba mitztzad echad, velibbattu haruach mitztzad acher. rava amar: kegon shellibba beruach metzuya, velibbattu haruach beruach sheenah metzuya. rabbi zera amar: kegon detzammera tzammore.
Rav ashe amar: ki amrinan zore veruach mesayyayto – hane mille leinyan shabbat, dimlechet machshevet asra tora; aval hacha – gerama bealma hu, ugerama binzakin patur.
Mishna hashsholeach et habbeera, veachla etzim o avanim o afar – chayyayv; shenneemar: "ki tetze esh umatza kotzim, veneechal gadish o hakkama o hassade, shallem yeshallem hammavir et habbeera".
Gemara amar rava: lema li dichtav rachamana "kotzim", "gadish", "kama" vesade"?

Tzerichi; dei ketav rachamana "kotzim", hava amena: kotzim hu dechayyayv rachamana – mishshum dishchiach esh gabbayyhu, ushechiach defasha; aval gadish – dela shechiach esh gabbayyhu, vela shechiach defasha, ema la. vei ketav rachamana "gadish", hava amena: gadish chayyayv rachamana – mishshum dehefsed merubbe hu; aval kotzim – dehefsed muat, ema la.
"Kama" lema li? ma kama begaluy – af kol begaluy.
Ulerabbi yehuda dimchayyev annizke tamun baesh, "kama" lema li? lerabbot kol baale koma. verabbanan, lerabbot kol baale koma mena lehu? nafka lehu meo hakkama".
Verabbi yehuda – "o" mibbee leh lechallek. verabbanan lechallek mena lehu? nafka lehu meo hassade".
Verabbi yehuda – ayyeyde dichtav rachamana "o hakkama", ketav "o hassade".

"Sade" lema li? leetoye lichacha niro vesichsecha avanav. velichtov rachamana "sade", vela bae hanach! tzericha; dei ketav rachamana "sade", hava amena: ma shebbassade – in, midde acharina – la; ka mashma lan.

Amar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yonatan: en pureanut baa laolam ella bizman sheharshaim baolam, veenah matchelet ella min hatztzaddikim techilla, shenneemar: "ki tetze esh umatza kotzim" – ematay esh yotza? bizman shekkotzim metzuyin lah. veenah matchelet ella min hatztzaddikim techilla, shenneemar: "veneechal gadish"; "veachal gadish" lo neemar, ella "veneechal gadish" – shenneechal gadish kevar.

Tane rav yosef, may dichtiv: "veattem lo tetzu ish mippetach beto ad boker"? kevan shennittan reshut lammashchit, eno mavchin ben tzaddikim lirshaim. velo od, ella shemmatchil min hatztzaddikim techilla, shenneemar: "vehichratti mimmech tzaddik verasha".
Bache rav yosef: kulle hay name leayin domin. amar leh abbaye: tevuta hu legabbayyhu, dichtiv: "ki mippene haraa neesaf hatztzaddik".
Amar rav yehuda amar rav:
b: Leolam yikkanes adam bechi tov" veyetze bechi tov", shenneemar: "veattem lo tetzu ish mippetach beto ad boker".

Tanu rabbanan: dever bair – kannes raglecha, shenneemar: "veattem lo tetzu ish mippetach beto ad boker". veomer: "lech ammi bo vachadarecha, usegor delatcha baadecha". veomer: "michutz teshakkel cherev, umechadarim ema".
May "veomer"? vechi tema: hane mille belelya, aval bimama la; ta shema: "lech ammi bo vachadarecha, usegor delatcha".

Vechi tema: hane mille [hecha] delekka ema miggavvay, aval hecha deikka ema miggavvay – ki nafek yatev bene inashe betzavvta bealma, tefe mealle; ta shema: "michutz teshakkel cherev umechadarim ema" – af al gav demechadarim ema, michutz teshakkel cherev.
Rava, beiddan ritcha hava sachar kavve, dichtiv: "ki ala mavet bechallonenu".
Tanu rabbanan: raav bair – pazzer raglecha, shenneemar: "vayhi raav baaretz, vayyered avram mitzrayma [lagur] (vayyagor) sham". veomer: "im amarnu navo hair veharaav bair, vamatnu sham".
May "veomer"? vechi tema: hane mille hecha delekka sefek nefashot, aval hecha deikka sefek nefashot – la; ta shema: "lechu venippela el machane aram, im yechayyunu nichye".

Tanu rabbanan: dever bair – al yehallech adam beemtza hadderech, mippene shemmalach hammavet mehallech beemtza hadderachim. dechevan dihiva leh reshuta, mesagge lehedya. shalom bair – al yehallech betzidde derachim. dechevan delet leh reshuta, michabbe chabboye umesagge.
Tanu rabbanan: dever bair – al yikkanes adam yachid levet hakkeneset, shemmalach hammavet mafkid sham kelav. vehane mille hecha dela karu beh dardeke, vela metzallu beh asara.
Tanu rabbanan: kelavim bochim – malach hammavet ba lair. kelavim mesachakim – eliyyahu hannavi ba lair. vehane mille delet behu nekeva.

Yatev rav amme verav assi kammeh derabbi yitzchak nappacha. mar amar leh: lema mar shemateta, umar amar leh: lema mar aggadta. patach lememar aggadta – vela shavek mar, patach lememar shematata – vela shavek mar.

Amar lahem: emshol lachem mashal, lema haddavar dome? leadam sheyyesh lo shete nashim, achat yalda veachat zekena. yalda melakketet lo levanot, zekena melakketet lo shechorot. nimtza kereach mikkan umikkan.

Amar lahen: i hachi, ema lechu milleta deshavya letarvayychu: "ki tetze esh umatza kotzim" – "tetze" meatzmah, "shallem yeshallem hammavir et habbeera". amar hakkadosh baruch hu: alay leshallem et habbeera shehivarti –
Ani hitztzayti esh betziyyon, shenneemar: "vayyatztzet esh betziyyon, vattochal yesodoteha"; vaani atid livnotah baesh, shenneemar: "vaani ehye lah chomat esh saviv, ulechavod ehye vetochah".
Shemateta – patach hakkatuv benizke mamono, vesiyyem benizke gufo; lomar lach: ishsho mishshum chitztzav.
"Vayyitavve david vayyomar: mi yashkeni mayim mibbor bet lechem asher bashshaar. vayyivkeu sheloshet haggibborim bemachane felishtim, vayyishavu mayim mibbor bet lechem asher bashshaar [vegomer]".
May ka mibbaya leh? amar rava amar rav nachman: tamun baesh kamibbaya leh, i kerabbi yehuda i kerabbanan, ufeshatu leh may difshatu leh.
Rav huna amar: gedishim disorim deyisrael havo, dahavo mittammeri pelishtim behu, veka mibbaya leh: mahu lehatztzil atzmo bemamon chavero?
Shelachu leh: asur lehatztzil atzmo bemamon chavero; aval atta melech atta, [umelech] poretz laasot lo derech veen mochin beyado.

Verabbanan veittema rabba bar mari amru: gedishim disorin deyisrael havo, ugedishin daadashim diflishtim; veka mibbaya lehu: mahu littol gedishin shel seorin deyisrael litten lifne behemto, al menat leshallem gedishin shel adashim diflishtim?
Shelachu leh: "chavol yashiv rasha, gezela yeshallem" – af al pi sheggezela meshallem, rasha hu. aval atta melech atta, umelech poretz laasot lo derech veen mochin beyado.
Bishlama leman deamar leachlofe – hayeynu dichtiv chad kera: "vattehi sham chelkat hassade melea adashim", uchetiv chad kera: "vattehi chelkat hassade melea seorim";
Ella leman deamar lemikle, may ibbaya lehu lehane tere kerae? amar lach: dahavo name gedishim daadashim deyisrael, dahavo mittammeru behu pelishtim.
Bishlama leman deamar lemikle – hayeynu dichtiv: "vayyityatztzev betoch hachelka vayyatztzileha"; ella leman deamar leachlofe, may "vayyatztzileha"?
Dela shevak lehu leachlofe.
Bishlama hane tarte, hayeynu dichtiv tere kerae;

a: Ella leman deamar tamun baesh kamibbaya leh, may ibbei leh kerae? amar lach: tamun vachada mehanach kamibbaya leh.

Bishlama leman deamar hane tarte, hayeynu dichtiv: "velo ava (david) lishtotam" – amar: kevan deikka issura, la nicha li. ella leman deamar tamun baesh ka mibbaya leh – mikkedi gemara hu dishlachu leh, may "lo ava (david) lishtotam"?
Dela amrinhu mishshemayyhu. amar, kach mekubbelani mibbet dino shel shemuel haramati: kol hammoser atzmo lamut al divre tora – en omrim devar halacha mishshemo.
"Vayyassech otam laAdonai" – bishlama leman deamar hane tarte, mishshum daavad leshem shamayim. ella leman deamar tamun baesh, may "vayyassech otam laAdonai"? deamrinhu mishshema digmara.
Mishna avra gader shehu gavoah arba ammot, o derech harabbim, o nahar – patur.
Gemara vehatanya: avra gader shehu gavoah arba ammot – chayyayv!

Amar rav pappa: tanna didan ka chashev millemala lematta: shesh ammot – patur, chamesh ammot – patur, ad arba ammot – patur. tanna bara millematta lemala ka chashev: shete ammot – chayyayv, shalosh ammot – chayyayv, ad arba ammot – chayyayv.
Amar rava: arba ammot sheamru defatur – afillu bisde kotzim. amar rav pappa: umissefat kotzim ulemala arba ammot.
Amar rav: lo shanu ella bekolachat, aval benichpefet – afillu ad mea amma chayyayv. ushemuel amar: matnitin benichpefet, aval bekolachat – afillu kol shehu patur.
Tanya kevoteh derav: bamme devarim amurim – bekolachat, aval benichpefet veetzim metzuyin lah – afillu ad mea mil chayyayv. avra nahar o shelulit shehem rechavim shemone ammot – patur.
Derech harabbim. man tanna? amar rava: rabbi eliezer hi – ditnan, rabbi eliezer omer: shesh esre ammot kederech reshut harabbim (patur).
O nahar. rav amar: nahar mammash, ushemuel amar: aritta dedallae.
Man deamar nehar mammash, af al gav delekka mayya; uman deamar aritta dedallae, i it beh mayya – in, aval let beh mayya – la.
Tenan hatam: veellu mafsikin lappea – hannachal, vehashshelulit, vederech hayyachid, vederech harabbim.
May shelulit? amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: mekom shemme geshamim shollin sham. rav bivi amar rabbi yochanan: ammat hammayim shemmechalleket shalal laagappeha.
Man deamar mekom shemme geshamim shollin sham – kol shekken ammat hammayim; uman deamar ammat hammayim – aval mekom shemme geshamim shollin sham la mafseki, dehanhu
b: Bagane deara mikkeru.

Mishna hammadlik betoch shello, ad kamma taavor haddeleka? rabbi elazar ben azarya omer: roin oto keillu hu beemtza bet kor. rabbi eliezer omer: shesh esre ammot, kederech reshut harabbim. rabbi akiva omer: chamishshim amma. rabbi shimon omer: "shallem yeshallem hammavir et habbeera" – hakkol lefi haddeleka.
Gemara velet leh lerabbi shimon shiura bidleka?

Vehatnan: lo yaamid adam tannur betoch habbayit, ella im ken yesh al gabbo gova dearba ammot. haya maamido baaliyyay – ad sheyyehe tachtav maaziva shelosha tefachim. uvakkira – tefach. veim hizzik – meshallem ma shehizzik.
Rabbi shimon omer: lo neemru shiurin hallalu, ella sheim hizzik – patur milleshallem!
Amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avu: hakkol lefi gova haddeleka.
Amar rav yosef amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: halacha kerabbi shimon. vechen amar rav nachman amar shemuel: halacha kerabbi shimon.
Mishna hammadlik et haggadish, vehayu bo kelim vedalku, rabbi yehuda omer: meshallem ma shebbetocho, vachachamim omrim: eno meshallem ella gadish shel chittin o shel seorin.
Haya gedi kafut lo, veeved samuch lo venisraf immo – chayyayv. eved kafut lo, ugedi samuch lo venisraf immo – patur.
Umodim chachamim lerabbi yehuda bemadlik et habbira, shehu meshallem kol ma shebbetochah; shekken derech bene adam lehanniach babbattim.

Gemara amar rav kahana: machaloket bemadlik betoch shello vehalcha veachla betoch shel chavero – derabbi yehuda mechayyayv annizke tamun baesh, verabbanan patri; aval bemadlik betoch shel chavero – divre hakkol meshallem kol ma shebbetocho.

Amar leh rava: i hachi, addetane sefa: modim chachamim lerabbi yehuda bemadlik et habbira – shemmeshallem kol ma shebbetochah, shekken derech bene adam lehanniach babbattim; liflog velitne bedida: bamme devarim amurim – bemadlik betoch shello, vehalcha veachla betoch shel chavero; aval madlik betoch shel chavero – divre hakkol meshallem kol ma shehaya betocho!

Ella amar rava: betarte peligi; peligi bemadlik betoch shello vehalcha veachla betoch shel chavero – derabbi yehuda mechayyayv attamun baesh, verabbanan savri la michayyayv. ufeligi name bemadlik beshel chavero – derabbi yehuda savar: meshallem kol ma shebbetocho, vaafillu arneki, verabbanan savri: kelim sheddarkan lehatemin begadish, kegon moriggin uchele bakar – hu dimshallem; kelim sheen darkan lehatemin begadish – la meshallem.

Tanu rabbanan: hammadlik et haggadish, vehayu bo kelim vedalku, rabbi yehuda omer: meshallem kol ma shehaya betocho, vachachamim omrim: eno meshallem ella gadish shel chittin o gadish shel seorin. veroin mekom kelim keillu hu male tevua.

a: Bamme devarim amurim – bemadlik betoch shello vehalcha vedalka betoch shel chavero, aval madlik betoch shel chavero – divre hakkol meshallem kol ma shehaya betocho.

Umode rabbi yehuda lachachamim bemashil makom lachavero lehagedish gadish, vehigdish vehitmin, sheen meshallem ella deme gadish bilvad. lehagedish chittin vehigdish seorin; seorin vehigdish chittin; chittin vechippan bisorin; seorin vechippan bechittim – sheeno meshallem ella deme seorin bilvad.

Amar rava: hannoten dinar zahav leishsha, veamar lah: "hizzahari bo, shel kesef hu"; hizzikattu – meshallemet dinar zahav, mishshum deamar la: may hava lich gabbeh deazzakteh. pasha bo – meshallemet shel kesef, deamra leh: netiruta dechaspa kabbeli alay, netiruta dedahava la kabbeli alay.

Amar leh rav mardochay lerav ashe: attun – bidrava matnitu la; anan – mimmatnita peshita lan: chittin vechippan bisorin, seorin vechippan bechittin – eno meshallem ella deme seorin bilvad. alma amar leh: "netiruta disare kabbeli alay", hacha name amara leh: "netiruta dedahava la kabbeli alay".
Amar rav: shemait milleta lerabbi yehuda, vela yadana may hi. amar shemuel: vela yada abba may shemia leh? lerabbi yehuda, dimchayyev al nizke tamun baesh – asu takkanat nigzal beishsho.
Bae ammemar: asu takkanat nigzal bemasor, o la? allibba deman deamar la dayyninan dina digrame – la tibbee lach, demasorot name la dayyninan;
Ella ki tibbee lach, allibba deman deamar dayyninan dina digrame – asu takkanat nigzal bemasor, demishteva veshakel, o la? teku.
Hahu gavra divtash bechaspeta dechavreh, shadyay benahara. ata mareh veamar: hachi vehachi hava li begavva. yatev rav ashe veka meayyen beh: ki hay gavvna may?

Amar leh ravina lerav acha bereh derava, veamri la rav acha bereh derava lerav ashe: lav hayeynu matnitin? ditnan: umodim chachamim lerabbi yehuda bemadlik et habbira, shemmeshallem kol ma shebbetocho; shekken derech bene adam lehanniach babbattim.
Amar leh: i deka taen zuze – hacha name, hacha bemay askinan – deka taen marganita. may? mi mannechi inashe marganita bechaspeta, o la? teku.

Amar leh rav yemar lerav ashe: taen kasa dechaspa bevira, may? amar leh: (chazena) [chazenan], i inish amid hu – deit leh kasa dechaspa, i name inish mehemna hu – demafkedi inashe gabbeh; mishteva veshakel. vei la, lav kol keminneh.
Amar leh rav adda bereh derav avya lerav ashe: ma ben gazlan lechamsan? amar leh: chamsan – yahev deme, gazlan – la yahev deme.
Amar leh: i yahev deme – chamsan karet leh?! vehaamar rav huna: telu vezabben – zevineh zevine! la kashya, ha deamar "rotze ani", ha dela amar "rotze ani".
b: Mishna getz sheyyatza mittachat happattish vehizzik – chayyayv.

Gamal shehaya taun pishtan, veavar birshut harabbim, venichnesa pishtano letoch hachanut vedalka benero shel chenvani, vehidlik et habbira – baal gamal chayyayv. hinniach chenvani nero mibbachutz – hachenvani chayyayv. rabbi yehuda omer: bener chanukka – patur.

Gemara amar ravina mishshemeh derava: shema minna midderabbi yehuda, ner chanukka – mitzva lehannichah betoch asara. dei salka datach lemala measara, ammay amar rabbi yehuda: ner chanukka patur? lema leh: hava leh leannocha lemala miggamal verochvo! ella lav shema minna: mitzva lehannichah betoch asara?
Amri: la; leolam ema lach afillu lemala measara, may amrat – ibbei lach leannocha lemala miggamal verochvo? kevan divmitzva ka asek, kulle hay la atrechu rabbanan.
Amar rav kahana, daresh rav natan bar minyome mishshemeh derabbi tanchum: ner chanukka shehinnichah lemala meesrim amma – pesula, kesukka uchemavoy.
Hadaran alach hakkones.

Mishna merubba middat tashlume chefel mimmiddat tashlume arbaa vachamishsha. shemmiddat tashlume chefel noheget ben bedavar sheyyesh bo ruach chayyim uven bedavar sheen bo ruach chayyim, umiddat tashlume arbaa vachamishsha enah noheget ella beshor vase bilvad – shenneemar: "ki yignov ish shor o se utevacho o mecharo vegomer".
En haggonev achar haggannav meshallem tashlume chefel, velo hattoveach velo hammocher achar haggannav meshallem tashlume arbaa vachamishsha.
Gemara veillu "middat tashlume chefel noheget ben begannav ben betoen taanat gannav, umiddat tashlume arbaa vachamishsha enah noheget ella begannav bilvad" – la katane.

Mesayyay leh lerabbi chiyyay bar abba, deamar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: hattoen taanat gannav befikkadon – meshallem tashlume chefel. tavach umachar – meshallem tashlume arbaa vachamishsha.

Ikka deamri: lema mesayyay leh lerabbi chiyyay bar abba – deamar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: hattoen taanat gannav befikkadon – meshallem tashlume chefel. tavach umachar – meshallem tashlume arbaa vachamishsha?
Mi katane: "en ben"?! "merubba" katane – tena veshayyayr.
Shemmiddat tashlume chefel noheget kulei. mena hane mille detanu rabbanan: "al kol devar pesha" – kalal, "al shor, al chamor, al se veal salma" – parat, "al kol aveda" – chazar vechalal;
Kelal uferat uchelal – i atta dan ella keen happerat; ma happerat meforash – davar hammittaltel vegufo mamon, af kol davar hammittaltel vegufo mamon.
Yatzu karkaot – sheenan mittaltelin; yatzu avadim – shehukkeshu lekarkaot; yatzu shetarot – sheaf al pi shemmittaltelin, en gufan mamon; yatza hekdesh – "reehu" ketiv.
I, ma happerat meforash – davar shennivlato metammea[5] bemagga uvemassa, af kol davar shennivlato metammea[5] bemagga uvemassa, aval ofot la!
